```kotlin
    // Design D2 of sub-project 5 (section 14.4): the pause for a call or the lock, "Continue the task?" and its timers.
    private fun pausedByLock(from: State = runningTask): State = Rules.next(from, Event.Screen(on = false)).state

    // "Continue the task?" after the unlock, spoken.
    private fun continueAsked(from: State = pausedByLock()): State =
        Rules.next(Rules.next(from.copy(screenSeen = true), Event.Screen(on = true)).state, Event.SpeechEnded).state

    @Test
    fun theUnlockAsksContinueTheTask() {
        val unlocked = Rules.next(pausedByLock().copy(screenSeen = true), Event.Screen(on = true))

        assertEquals(
            listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.ContinueQuestion), Effect.Say(Reply.ContinueQuestion), Effect.WaitForAnswer(), Effect.ArmTouches),
            unlocked.effects,
        )
        assertEquals(TaskAsk.CONTINUE, unlocked.state.taskAsking)
        assertEquals(TaskPhase.PAUSED, unlocked.state.taskPhase)
        assertEquals(Recognition.ALL, Rules.next(unlocked.state, Event.SpeechEnded).state.recognition)
    }

    @Test
    fun yesResumesThePausedTaskAndNoSilenceOrStopCancelIt() {
        val asked = continueAsked()

        val resumed = heard(asked, "Yes, please.")
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Yes, please.")), Effect.ResumeTask(1)), resumed.effects)
        assertEquals(TaskPhase.RUNNING, resumed.state.taskPhase)
        assertEquals(Work.RUNNING_TASK, resumed.state.work)
        assertEquals(Effect.ResumeTask(1), heard(asked, "Kestrel, continue", named = true).effects.last())

        for (no in listOf(heard(asked, "No."), heard(asked, "Stop"), Rules.next(asked, Event.AnswerWaitEnded(asked.wait)))) {
            assertTrue(Effect.CancelTask in no.effects)
            assertEquals(null, no.state.taskPhase)
            assertTrue(no.state.cancelled)
        }
        // Other speech is ignored during the question.
        assertEquals(Step(asked, listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Scroll down")))), heard(asked, "Scroll down"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aTouchAnswersContinueTheTaskOnlyOnceASecondHasPassed() {
        val asked = continueAsked()

        assertEquals(Step(asked), Rules.next(asked, Event.OwnerTouched))
        val armed = Rules.next(asked, Event.TouchesArmed(asked.continueAsked)).state
        assertTrue(armed.touchesArmed)
        assertTrue(Effect.CancelTask in Rules.next(armed, Event.OwnerTouched).effects)
        // An older question's second changes nothing, and a paused task without the question ignores touches.
        assertEquals(Step(asked), Rules.next(asked, Event.TouchesArmed(asked.continueAsked - 1)))
        assertEquals(Step(pausedByLock()), Rules.next(pausedByLock(), Event.OwnerTouched))
    }

    @Test
    fun kestrelOverContinueTheTaskLeavesTheQuestionOpen() {
        // The spotter hears "Kestrel" while Kestrel still speaks "Continue the task?".
        val speaking = Rules.next(pausedByLock().copy(screenSeen = true), Event.Screen(on = true)).state

        val spotted = Rules.next(speaking, Event.Spotted(Keyword.KESTREL)).state
        assertEquals(TaskAsk.CONTINUE, spotted.taskAsking)
        assertEquals(Work.IDLE, spotted.work)
        assertEquals(Effect.ResumeTask(1), heard(Rules.next(spotted, Event.SpeechEnded).state, "Kestrel, continue.", named = true).effects.last())
    }

    @Test
    fun aPausedTaskLetsTheInstantCommandsRunAndRefusesANewTask() {
        val asked = continueAsked()
        val replaced = heard(asked, "Stop. Kestrel, open Viber.", named = true)
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Stop. Kestrel, open Viber.")), Effect.CancelTask, Effect.RunTask(2, "open Viber.")), replaced.effects)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Kestrel, open Viber.")), Effect.Show(Feedback.AnswerContinueFirst)),
            heard(asked, "Kestrel, open Viber.", named = true).effects,
        )
        // Without the question, as during a call with the phone unlocked, an instant command runs.
        val paused = pausedByLock().copy(screenOn = true)
        assertTrue(heard(paused, "Scroll down").effects.last() is Effect.RunCommand)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCallDuringAQuestionWithdrawsItAndTheEndOfTheCallAsksToContinue() {
        val question = asking(TaskAsk.CONFIRM)

        val ringing = Rules.next(question, Event.CallState(CallState.RINGING))
        assertTrue(Effect.PauseTask(1, PauseCause.INCOMING_CALL) in ringing.effects)
        assertEquals(null, ringing.state.taskAsking)
        val active = Rules.next(ringing.state, Event.CallState(CallState.ACTIVE)).state
        assertEquals(TaskPhase.PAUSED, active.taskPhase)

        val ended = Rules.next(active, Event.CallState(CallState.IDLE))
        assertEquals(Mode.LISTENING, ended.state.mode)
        assertTrue(Effect.Say(Reply.ContinueQuestion) in ended.effects)
        assertEquals(TaskAsk.CONTINUE, ended.state.taskAsking)
        // After a call that ended while the phone was locked, the question waits for the unlock.
        val locked = Rules.next(Rules.next(active, Event.Screen(on = false)).state, Event.CallState(CallState.IDLE))
        assertEquals(null, locked.state.taskAsking)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCallThatBecomesActiveWithoutRingingPausesForTheBackstop() {
        val active = Rules.next(runningTask, Event.CallState(CallState.ACTIVE))

        assertTrue(Effect.PauseTask(1, PauseCause.OUTGOING_CALL) in active.effects)
        assertEquals(Mode.IN_CALL, active.state.mode)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCallDuringAHandOverDoesNotPauseIt() {
        val handed = handedOver()

        val ringing = Rules.next(handed, Event.CallState(CallState.RINGING))

        assertEquals(TaskPhase.HANDED_OVER, ringing.state.taskPhase)
        assertFalse(ringing.effects.any { it is Effect.PauseTask })
        assertEquals(TaskPhase.HANDED_OVER, Rules.next(handed, Event.Screen(on = false)).state.taskPhase)
    }

    @Test
    fun aLockDuringContinueTheTaskWithdrawsTheQuestionUntilTheNextUnlock() {
        val asked = continueAsked()

        val dark = Rules.next(asked, Event.Screen(on = false))

        assertEquals(null, dark.state.taskAsking)
        assertEquals(TaskPhase.PAUSED, dark.state.taskPhase)
        assertFalse(dark.effects.any { it is Effect.PauseTask })
        assertTrue(Effect.Say(Reply.ContinueQuestion) in Rules.next(dark.state, Event.Screen(on = true)).effects)
    }

    @Test
    fun aPauseOfThirtyMinutesEndsTheTaskAndItsReportWaitsForTheUnlock() {
        val paused = pausedByLock()

        val expired = Rules.next(paused, Event.PauseExpired(paused.pause))
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.ExpirePause(1)), expired.effects)
        assertEquals(null, expired.state.taskPhase)
        assertEquals(Step(paused), Rules.next(paused, Event.PauseExpired(paused.pause - 1)))

        val report = "I stopped the task because it was paused for a long time. I opened Viber."
        val held = Rules.next(expired.state, Event.TaskEnded(1, report))
        assertEquals(emptyList<Effect>(), held.effects)
        assertEquals(report, held.state.heldReport)

        val unlocked = Rules.next(held.state.copy(screenSeen = true), Event.Screen(on = true))
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.Say(Reply.Text(report))), unlocked.effects)
        assertEquals(null, unlocked.state.heldReport)
    }

    @Test
    fun stayOffAfterAnUnlockWaitsUntilThePausedTaskHasEnded() {
        val paused = pausedByLock(runningTask.copy(onWakeUp = WakeUpMode.STAY_OFF))

        val asked = Rules.next(paused.copy(screenSeen = true), Event.Screen(on = true))
        assertEquals(Mode.LISTENING, asked.state.mode)
        assertTrue(asked.state.offAfterTask)
        assertTrue(Effect.Say(Reply.ContinueQuestion) in asked.effects)

        val no = heard(Rules.next(asked.state, Event.SpeechEnded).state, "No.")
        val reported = Rules.next(no.state, Event.TaskEnded(1, "Cancelled. I didn't change anything."))
        assertEquals(Mode.LISTENING, reported.state.mode)
        val off = Rules.next(reported.state, Event.SpeechEnded)
        assertEquals(Mode.OFF, off.state.mode)
        assertTrue(Effect.StopService in off.effects)

        // An expired pause's report is spoken first, and then Kestrel turns off.
        val expired = Rules.next(paused, Event.PauseExpired(paused.pause)).state
        val held = Rules.next(expired, Event.TaskEnded(1, "Report.")).state
        val spoken = Rules.next(held.copy(screenSeen = true), Event.Screen(on = true))
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.Say(Reply.Text("Report."))), spoken.effects)
        assertEquals(Mode.OFF, Rules.next(spoken.state, Event.SpeechEnded).state.mode)
    }

    @Test
    fun theAssistantGestureAndLateAnswersCountAPausedTaskAsATask() {
        val paused = pausedByLock().copy(screenOn = true, speeches = 1)

        assertEquals(Step(paused, listOf(Effect.StopSaying)), Rules.next(paused, Event.Assist))
    }

    @Test
    fun deleteHistoryAsksAndOnlyYesDeletes() {
        val asked = heard(listening, "Kestrel, delete the history.", named = true)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Kestrel, delete the history.")), Effect.Say(Reply.DeleteHistoryQuestion), Effect.WaitForAnswer()),
            asked.effects,
        )
        assertTrue(asked.state.deleteAsking)

        val yes = heard(asked.state, "Yes.")
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Yes.")), Effect.DeleteHistory), yes.effects)
        assertFalse(yes.state.deleteAsking)
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Go on"))), heard(asked.state, "Go on").effects)
        assertFalse(Rules.next(asked.state, Event.AnswerWaitEnded(asked.state.wait)).state.deleteAsking)
        assertEquals(Effect.Say(Reply.HistoryDeleted(true)), Rules.next(listening, Event.HistoryDeleted(true)).effects.last())
        // While a task exists, it is ignored (section 11.10).
        assertEquals(Step(runningTask), heard(runningTask, "Kestrel, clear history", named = true))
        assertEquals(listOf(Effect.Show(Feedback.Heard("Kestrel, delete history"))), heard(handedOver(), "Kestrel, delete history", named = true).effects)

    @Test
    fun rememberForgetAndSaveThatAsRunAsKestrelsOwnTask() {
        val remember = heard(listening, "Kestrel, remember that the gate code is blue.", named = true)
        assertEquals(Effect.RunMemoryTask(1, Request.Remember("the gate code", "blue")), remember.effects.last())
        assertEquals(TaskPhase.RUNNING, remember.state.taskPhase)
        assertEquals(Effect.RunMemoryTask(1, Request.Forget("the gate code")), heard(listening, "Kestrel, forget the gate code", named = true).effects.last())
        assertEquals(Effect.RunMemoryTask(1, Request.SaveRoutine("test routine")), heard(listening, "Kestrel, save that as test routine.", named = true).effects.last())
        // A form that the parser does not take runs as a task.
        assertEquals(Effect.RunTask(1, "remember to buy milk"), heard(listening, "Kestrel, remember to buy milk", named = true).effects.last())
        // During a hand-over it waits, as a task does.
        assertEquals(Effect.Show(Feedback.FinishHandOverFirst), heard(handedOver(), "Kestrel, forget the gate code", named = true).effects.last())
    }

    @Test
    fun thePauseEventsAndEffectsPrintNoWords() {
        val printed = listOf(

            Request.Forget("secret"),
            Request.SaveRoutine("secret"),
            pausedByLock().copy(heldReport = "secret"),
        ).joinToString()

        assertFalse(printed, printed.contains("secret"))
```

Create `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/CallBackstop.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.app.listen.CallApi
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.PauseCause

/**
 * The backstop against a call that an action of the agent placed (design D13 of sub-project 5; review B3-I1). The agent
 * hands every call over, so no action of its own should start one, and this backstop needs no list of apps: when a pause
 * of the Orchestrator comes from a call that became active without ringing ([PauseCause.OUTGOING_CALL]) within
 * [WINDOW_MILLIS] after the agent's last action, the task stops at once ([Verdict.STOP]) and, with Android's permission
 * for calls, Kestrel ends that call. A call that rang is an incoming call: Kestrel never ends it, and the task only pauses
 * (section 14.4). The Orchestrator pauses only a running task, never a hand-over or a paused task, so a call that the
 * owner places himself then never reaches the backstop. Android reports the call state only with `READ_PHONE_STATE`, so
 * without it nothing reaches the backstop either. [clock] is monotonic, such as `SystemClock.elapsedRealtime`.
 */
internal class CallBackstop(private val calls: CallApi, private val clock: () -> Long) {
    enum class Verdict { PAUSE, STOP }

    @Volatile
    private var lastAction: Long? = null

    /** The agent performed an action on the screen or sent an intent just now. */
    fun acted() {
        lastAction = clock()
    }

    /** A new task starts: an action of an earlier task never counts. */
    fun forget() {
        lastAction = null
    }

    /** What the pause of the running task for [cause] means. */
    fun onPause(cause: PauseCause): Verdict {
        val last = lastAction ?: return Verdict.PAUSE
        if (cause != PauseCause.OUTGOING_CALL || clock() - last > WINDOW_MILLIS) return Verdict.PAUSE
        try {
            if (calls.allowed()) calls.end()
        } catch (e: SecurityException) {
            // The owner took the permission back meanwhile; the task stops all the same.
        }
        return Verdict.STOP
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "CallBackstop(acted=${lastAction != null})"

    companion object {
        const val WINDOW_MILLIS = 5_000L
    }
}
```

```kotlin
    /**
     * "remember that <key> is <value>", "forget <key>" or "save that as <name>" (design D2 of sub-project 5), with the
     * owner's own words and letter case; any other form, such as "remember to buy milk", is no memory request and runs as

    private fun memory(transcript: String, rest: List<Word>): Request.Memory? {
        val words = rest.map { it.text }
        fun from(index: Int, until: Int = rest.size): String =
            transcript.substring(rest[index].range.first, rest[until - 1].range.last + 1).trim().trimEnd('.', '!', '?', ',').trim()

                val split = (3 until words.size - 1).firstOrNull { words[it] == "is" } ?: return null
                Request.Remember(from(2, split), from(split + 1))
            }
            words.size >= 2 && words[0] == "forget" && phrase(rest.drop(1)) !in NO_KEYS -> Request.Forget(from(1))
            words.size >= 4 && words[0] == "save" && words[1] in setOf("that", "this") && words[2] == "as" -> Request.SaveRoutine(from(3))
            else -> null
        }
    }
```

```kotlin
    }

    // A transcript while Kestrel is idle: during a hand-over or a pause the task's own rules come first (design D2 of
    // sub-project 5).
    private fun idle(state: State, request: Request, event: Event.Heard, shown: Effect, spokeAt: Long? = null): Step = when (state.taskPhase) {
        TaskPhase.HANDED_OVER -> whileHandedOver(state, request, event.text, shown, spokeAt)
        TaskPhase.PAUSED -> whilePaused(state, request, event, shown, spokeAt)
        else -> whileIdle(state, request, event.text, shown, spokeAt)
    }

    // Design D2 of sub-project 5 (section 14.4): while a task is paused, nothing of it runs and the instant commands work.
    // "Continue the task?" takes yes, which resumes the task, or no; any other speech is ignored then. "Stop" and "cancel"
    // cancel the task, "Stop. Kestrel, [task]" cancels it and runs the new one, and any other task waits for the answer.
    private fun whilePaused(state: State, request: Request, event: Event.Heard, shown: Effect, spokeAt: Long?): Step {
        val asking = state.taskAsking == TaskAsk.CONTINUE
        when {
            request is Request.Stop || (asking && request is Request.Other && startsWithStop(event.text)) -> return cancelTask(state, shown)
            request is Request.Task && request.stopFirst -> return cancelTask(state, shown).then { runTask(it, request.text) }
            request is Request.Task || request is Request.Memory -> return Step(state, listOf(shown, Effect.Show(Feedback.AnswerContinueFirst)))
            request == Request.PauseListening -> return cancelTask(state, shown).then { changeMode(it, Mode.PAUSED) }
            request == Request.TurnOff -> return turnOff(state, shown)
        }
        if (!asking) return whileIdle(state, request, event.text, shown, spokeAt)
        return when (TaskAnswers.read(TaskAsk.CONTINUE, event.text, event.named, request)) {
            TaskAnswers.YES -> Step(
                state.copy(work = Work.RUNNING_TASK, taskPhase = TaskPhase.RUNNING, taskAsking = null, voiceAnswers = true, touchesArmed = false),
                listOf(shown, Effect.ResumeTask(state.task)),
            )
            TaskAnswers.NO -> cancelTask(state, shown)
            else -> Step(state, listOf(shown))
        }
    }

    // What the bar says to a new task while one waits: for the end of its hand-over, or for the answer after its pause.
    private fun waitFirst(state: State): Feedback =
        if (state.taskPhase == TaskPhase.PAUSED) Feedback.AnswerContinueFirst else Feedback.FinishHandOverFirst

    // Design D2 and D15 of sub-project 5: while the owner does a step by hand, the instant commands work as when idle,
```

```kotlin
    // Design D2 of sub-project 5 (section 14.4): a call or the lock pauses a running task instead of cancelling it. Its
    // open question is withdrawn, the agent stops at its next gate, and 30 minutes later the task ends. An open "Continue
    // the task?" is asked again when the owner is back.
    private fun pauseTask(state: State, cause: PauseCause): Step = when {
        state.work == Work.RUNNING_TASK -> Step(
            state.copy(
                work = Work.IDLE,
                taskPhase = TaskPhase.PAUSED,
                taskAsking = null,
                voiceAnswers = true,
                touchesArmed = false,
                pause = state.pause + 1,
            ),
            listOf(Effect.PauseTask(state.task, cause), Effect.TimePause),
        )
        state.taskAsking == TaskAsk.CONTINUE -> Step(state.copy(taskAsking = null, touchesArmed = false))
        else -> Step(state)
    }

    // Design D2 of sub-project 5: when the owner is back (the unlock, or the end of a call with the phone unlocked), a
    // paused task asks "Continue the task?", and the report of a task that a long pause ended is spoken now.
    private fun backToTask(state: State): Step {
        if (state.mode == Mode.OFF || state.inCall || !state.screenOn) return Step(state)
        val held = state.heldReport
        return when {
            held != null -> say(state.copy(heldReport = null), Reply.Text(held))
            state.taskPhase == TaskPhase.PAUSED && state.taskAsking == null -> askContinue(state)
            else -> Step(state)
        }
    }

    // A touch answers the question only after ArmTouches' second, when the unlock's own touches have passed.
    private fun askContinue(state: State): Step = say(
        state.copy(taskAsking = TaskAsk.CONTINUE, voiceAnswers = true, touchesArmed = false, continueAsked = state.continueAsked + 1),
        Reply.ContinueQuestion,
        Effect.Show(Feedback.ContinueQuestion),
    ).then { waitForAnswer(it) }.then { Step(it, listOf(Effect.ArmTouches)) }

    // Design D2 of sub-project 5 (spec 13.5): "Kestrel, delete history" asks first, with a command question's waits.
    private fun askDelete(state: State, vararg first: Effect): Step =
        say(state.copy(deleteAsking = true), Reply.DeleteHistoryQuestion, *first).then { waitForAnswer(it) }

    // Only "yes" deletes the history; any other answer ends the question and does nothing.
    private fun deleteAnswer(state: State, event: Event.Heard, shown: Effect): Step {
        val asked = state.copy(deleteAsking = false)
        return if (TaskAnswers.saysYes(event.text, event.named)) Step(asked, listOf(shown, Effect.DeleteHistory)) else Step(asked, listOf(shown))
    }

    // "Remember", "forget" and "save that as" run as a task of Kestrel's own, so that their questions work as a task's.
    private fun runMemory(state: State, request: Request.Memory, vararg first: Effect): Step {
        val task = state.task + 1
        val running = state.copy(work = Work.RUNNING_TASK, task = task, cancelled = false, taskPhase = TaskPhase.RUNNING, taskAsking = null, voiceAnswers = true)
        return Step(running, first.toList() + Effect.RunMemoryTask(task, request))
    }

    private fun ownTask(state: State, task: Int): Boolean = task == state.task && state.taskExists
```

```kotlin
        val woken = when (state.onWakeUp) {
            WakeUpMode.RESUME -> Step(changed)
            WakeUpMode.LISTEN -> changeMode(changed, Mode.LISTENING)
            // "Stay off" waits until a paused task has ended, so that it never drops its question or its report.
            WakeUpMode.STAY_OFF -> if (waiting) Step(changed.copy(offAfterTask = true)) else turnOff(changed)
        }
        return woken.then { backToTask(it) }
    }

    // Section 8.5: 30 s without speech pause listening. A timer that ran out while Kestrel spoke, waited for a task, ran
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator

import dev.kestrel.commands.SpokenNumbers
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer

/**
 * The answers that a task's question takes (design D2 of sub-project 5), read on Normalizer's words, so that "Confirm."
 * counts like "confirm" and "Kestrel, continue" like "continue". A confirmation goes ahead on "confirm", "yes" or "send
 * it"; a yes-or-no question and "Continue the task?" take "yes", "continue" or "go on"; both take "no". The polite words
 * and the name may come with them. A free question takes any words, and a number question a number. Anything else is no
 * answer, and the question goes on.
 */
internal object TaskAnswers {
    const val YES = "yes"
    const val NO = "no"

    private val FILLERS = setOf("please", "now", "ok", "okay", "thanks", "thank", "you", "oh", "well")
    private val CONFIRM = setOf("confirm", "yes", "send it")
    private val GO_ON = setOf("yes", "continue", "go on")

    /** The answer to a question of [kind] in the transcript [text], or null when it gives none. */
    fun read(kind: TaskAsk, text: String, named: Boolean, request: Request): String? = when (kind) {
        TaskAsk.CONFIRM -> yesOrNo(text, named, CONFIRM)
        TaskAsk.YES_NO, TaskAsk.CONTINUE -> yesOrNo(text, named, GO_ON)
        TaskAsk.PICK_NUMBER -> text.trim().takeIf { SpokenNumbers.answer(it) != null }
        TaskAsk.FREE -> when (request) {
            is Request.Task -> request.text
            is Request.Other -> request.text
            else -> text.trim()
        }.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
    }

    private fun yesOrNo(text: String, named: Boolean, yes: Set<String>): String? {
        val phrase = Normalizer.words(text).filter { it !in FILLERS && Requests.read(it, named) != Request.Name }.joinToString(" ")
        return when (phrase) {
            in yes -> YES
            NO -> NO
            else -> null
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator

import dev.kestrel.commands.SpokenNumbers
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer

/**
 * The answers that a task's question takes (design D2 of sub-project 5), read on Normalizer's words, so that "Confirm."
 * counts like "confirm" and "Kestrel, continue" like "continue". A confirmation goes ahead on "confirm", "yes" or "send
 * it"; a yes-or-no question and "Continue the task?" take "yes", "continue" or "go on"; both take "no". The polite words
 * and the name may come with them. A free question takes any words, and a number question a number. Anything else is no
 * answer, and the question goes on.
 */
internal object TaskAnswers {
    const val YES = "yes"
    const val NO = "no"

    private val FILLERS = setOf("please", "now", "ok", "okay", "thanks", "thank", "you", "oh", "well")
    private val CONFIRM = setOf("confirm", "yes", "send it")
    private val GO_ON = setOf("yes", "continue", "go on")

    /** The answer to a question of [kind] in the transcript [text], or null when it gives none. */
    fun read(kind: TaskAsk, text: String, named: Boolean, request: Request): String? = when (kind) {
        TaskAsk.CONFIRM -> yesOrNo(text, named, CONFIRM)
        TaskAsk.YES_NO, TaskAsk.CONTINUE -> yesOrNo(text, named, GO_ON)
        TaskAsk.PICK_NUMBER -> text.trim().takeIf { SpokenNumbers.answer(it) != null }
        TaskAsk.FREE -> when (request) {
            is Request.Task -> request.text
            is Request.Other -> request.text
            else -> text.trim()
        }.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
    }

    /** Whether [text] is "yes", with the polite words and the name, and nothing else ("Delete the history?"). */
    fun saysYes(text: String, named: Boolean): Boolean = phrase(text, named) == YES

    private fun phrase(text: String, named: Boolean): String =
        Normalizer.words(text).filter { it !in FILLERS && Requests.read(it, named) != Request.Name }.joinToString(" ")

    private fun yesOrNo(text: String, named: Boolean, yes: Set<String>): String? {
        return when (phrase(text, named)) {
            in yes -> YES
            NO -> NO
            else -> null
        }
    }
}
```

In `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-kestrel-design.md`, replace

```markdown
- While a call rings, Kestrel stops speaking at once, records also on the lock screen (section 8.5), and understands only "answer", "answer on speaker" and "decline", with or without its name and with the polite words of its other phrases. Everything else is ignored. With the permission `ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS`, it answers and declines through Android's call API (`TelecomManager.acceptRingingCall()` and `endCall()`), which works on the lock screen and does not depend on the phone app's layout or language. Without it, it clicks the control whose content description or text is "Answer" or "Decline" in the windows on the screen of the phone app and of SystemUI only (for the call's heads-up notification), such as the call's heads-up notification or the incoming-call screen over the lock screen, through its accessibility service. The phone app is Android's default phone app or a known in-call screen (Google's, AOSP's or One UI's, whose in-call screen has a package of its own). A control with the same label in another app's window, such as a video player's "Mute", is never clicked and never counts as done; while the call rings, another app's heads-up notification could have an action labelled "Answer" or "Decline", which Kestrel could press. It does not search the call notification's own actions, so when the owner has pushed the heads-up notification away, it finds nothing to click and says so. The labels are English; the phone app's other languages come with Serbian support (section 21). "Answer on speaker" answers, brings the in-call screen to the front once the call is active, waits until it is the app window in front (up to 3 s), and clicks its "Speaker" control unless the control is on already; if it finds none, Kestrel shows "I answered, but I couldn't turn on the speaker." Every failure shows its reason on the feedback bar (section 14) while the accessibility service runs; without the service there is no bar, and Kestrel cannot speak during a call, so a failure shows nothing.
- During the call Kestrel is paused, and its microphone is off. With the setting "Commands during a call" (off by default, section 15), it listens for "Kestrel, hang up" (Android's call API; without the permission, Kestrel clicks the in-call screen's "End call" control, which Google's phone app has (found on kestrel-api37 in plan 2D's Task 3), and says that it needs the permission only when it finds no such control), "Kestrel, mute" and "Kestrel, speaker" (the in-call screen's controls, which stay on when they are on already, so a second "mute" does not unmute the call) while the phone is unlocked. For these controls and "End call", Kestrel brings the in-call screen to the front, clicks only once it is the app window in front, and searches only the phone app's windows, not SystemUI's, so that neither the app that the owner uses during the call nor another app's notification is touched; `listen-check.ps1` checks this, and a second "mute", with Google's phone app on kestrel-api37. During the call, the command must start with the name, because the caller's voice can come through the speaker; a command without the name first is ignored. During the call Kestrel transcribes only the utterances at whose start the keyword spotter heard "Kestrel", as while it is paused, so that it never transcribes the call's conversation; when the spotter misses the name, the owner says the command again. The polite words may come with it, as while a call rings. The other person can hear these commands. They need Kestrel's accessibility service: without it, Android silences Kestrel's recording during an active call (prototype P3), and "mute" and "speaker" press the in-call screen's controls through it. Android refuses Kestrel's audio focus while a call rings or lasts, so Kestrel's replies go to the feedback bar.
- After the call, the previous listening mode returns. If the call interrupted a task, the task is cancelled; sub-project 5 asks "Continue the task?" (section 14.4).
- Emergency calls (plan 3C). Kestrel never acts by voice on what may call an emergency number without the owner's "yes, call". R1: an element whose name (text, content description or view ID, and the label of an element that takes a touch) holds the word "emergency" or "SOS", or whose nearest clickable parent's does, such as the emergency buttons of the power menu and the lock screen. A scroll that Kestrel aims itself ("scroll down", "scroll to top", "swipe forwards", also on a list that the owner names) presses no element, because it uses the list's scroll action or a swipe across the list, or across the window when no list scrolls, that is longer than the touch slop, so R1 does not apply to it; R2 does (plan 4D). R2: every window of a phone package (the default phone app, `com.android.phone`, `com.android.dialer`, `com.google.android.dialer`, `com.samsung.android.dialer`, `com.samsung.android.incallui`, `com.android.server.telecom` or One UI's emergency dialer `com.samsung.android.app.telephonyui`) while one of its windows shows an element or a title that R1 names, an element whose own text or content description, trimmed, is as a whole a number that Android reports as an emergency number or cannot check (a call-history row or a search result "112"; a time such as "08:15", a date with a word, such as "17 Nov", or a name with a number in it is none, while a date of digits alone whose digits make an emergency number, such as "9/11", counts, which only asks more), or a number field that shows an emergency number (also when Android cannot check it), a number with fewer than 5 digits or with `*` or `#`, or a text that reads as no number: every action on their elements except a tap on a digit key and the actions on the number field and its delete key, so that the owner can still type and correct the number by voice (a long press on a digit key needs the yes, because on 1 it calls the voicemail and on 0 it types "+"), and every gesture that starts or ends inside them, also a swipe that starts on an element of another window. A window of a phone package in which Kestrel finds no number field to read (none, a field that is no text field and has not the view ID `digits`, or no element yet, as while the window starts) needs the yes for every action that can reach into it: a point, a grid square, a gesture, and a tap or a long press on any of its elements, the digit keys too. Kestrel asks "That may call an emergency number. Say 'yes, call' to do it." and acts only on "yes, call", with or without its name after it, and only while the command still finds the same elements; any other answer, the question's timer, a touch or a cancel ends the command. Kestrel reads the number field as the phone app itself reports it right before the decision and, while a window of a phone package is on the screen, again right before it lets the command go on; the screen part then acts on its own snapshot of the screen. A field that it cannot read again needs the yes too. "Search for" in a phone app's window types no query with a digit, because a number there could start a call; it searches for names. "Call [number]" with an emergency number asks the same question after its announcement and never presses Call through the countdown alone (section 13.6). This policy is the owner's decision; one constant switches it to touch only, where Kestrel refuses with "Tap it yourself for an emergency call." and "call [number]" only opens the phone app. Not covered: the time between the guard's last read and the screen part's action, in which a phone app's window can appear or its number can change; an emergency number that another control of a phone app's window calls while no element there shows it as a whole number, such as a favourite or a call-history row that shows a name, or a speed-dial key, in a window with a text field that Kestrel reads (the number field or a search box) that shows no number or one that Kestrel would call; a contact's page in an app outside the phone packages, such as the Contacts app; the number that the phone app will actually call, which Kestrel cannot read, because it reads only the number field; a window whose app Android does not report yet; phones in other languages than English for R1, whose words are English; letters alone in a phone app's text field other than the one with the view ID `digits`; and an app's own emergency feature outside the phone packages whose names do not say "emergency" or "SOS".
- The setup checklist asks for both permissions in an optional step (section 15). A grant while Kestrel listens counts at once, or, when it is made in Android's settings, when the owner next opens Kestrel's settings.
```

In `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-kestrel-design.md`, replace

```markdown
| Network log | Time, host, path, request and response size, status, and the task it belongs to. The path is the request's path with the parts that name the owner's project or account replaced, such as Vertex's project or a Bedrock model; a failed request's detail is the error's class, except for a request that the allowlist refused, whose detail names the host and the rule | 7 days |

- Both logs are encrypted and can be viewed in settings. A button in settings wipes both after a confirmation; "Kestrel, delete history" by voice, after a spoken confirmation, comes with the agent (sub-project 5).
- The logs leave the phone only when the owner exports them to a file of their choice. The export is one JSON file with both logs and all their entries, oldest first, with times in UTC. Kestrel writes it 100 entries at a time, so that a week of prompts never has to fit in memory, and leaves out an entry that it can no longer decrypt.
- The activity log's entries have a kind: an action, a note, an error, a prompt (the new part of a model call's request), a reply (with its usage and cost) or a safety decision, and a task's entries carry the task's ID (sub-project 5's design D25). The log pages show the newest entries and say how many.
```

```markdown
| Network log | Time, host, path, request and response size, status, and the task it belongs to. The path is the request's path with the parts that name the owner's project or account replaced, such as Vertex's project or a Bedrock model; a failed request's detail is the error's class, except for a request that the allowlist refused, whose detail names the host and the rule | 7 days |

- Both logs are encrypted and can be viewed in settings. A button in settings wipes both after a confirmation. "Kestrel, delete history" (also "delete my history" and "clear history") asks "Delete the activity log and the network log? Say yes or no." and wipes both only after "yes"; Kestrel then says "I deleted the history." or "I couldn't delete the history." It needs no model, and while a task exists Kestrel ignores it.

Kestrel writes it 100 entries at a time, so that a week of prompts never has to fit in memory, and leaves out an entry that it can no longer decrypt.
- The activity log's entries have a kind: an action, a note, an error, a prompt (the new part of a model call's request), a reply (with its usage and cost) or a safety decision, and a task's entries carry the task's ID (sub-project 5's design D25). The log pages show the newest entries and say how many.
```

Design D2, D24 and D28; deferred items 1, 2 and 4 (D32). `AgentRunner` replaces `Listening.runTask`: it returns at once, runs the agent in Kestrel's scope, turns the owner's touches into `OwnerTouched` (with an activity-log line "possible late echo after <n> ms" for a touch up to 1 s after Kestrel's last node action, D19), and ends every task with `TaskEnded` and its sentence (`AgentTexts.sentence`, built by code from the report, D24). A task that cannot start says why (`Prepared.Refused`, or "I couldn't start the task." after a failure, which goes to the report by its classes), and both silent paths get that sentence too: `Listening`'s `afterStopping` and the `Orchestrator`'s own `TaskEnded` when `perform(Effect.RunTask)` throws (`taskFailed`). The report of a task that "Stop. Kestrel, <task>" replaced goes to the bar as "Cancelled: <what it did>". `CancelTask` cancels the agent's job, `ExpirePause` cancels it as paused too long, and the other effects reach the task's owner port; a pause that `CallBackstop` reads as the agent's call stops the task with "I stopped the task because a call started right after my last action.". The memory requests of Task 11 run as Kestrel's own local tasks, which ask the owner first and change nothing without his yes; "save that as" uses the steps of a task that finished in the last 10 minutes (D23), and a release build offers a routine after a task's second run with the same signature. A debuggable build (D28) runs a task only with a model that a hook or a device test installed (`modelOverride`), or with the hook's extra `live` while a live sitting is open (`AGENT_LIVE_SESSION`); every other task ends at once with "I couldn't start the task: this test build runs tasks only with a test script or in a live session.", so that no plan step, device test or script can call a provider. This is why the voice device tests need no runner of their own (D2's last bullet): their tasks end at once with that sentence. Until Task 14 the graph's environment refuses every task with "I couldn't start the task.".

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentPorts
import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentSettings
import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.Fact
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Gate
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.NoEyes
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.OwnerPort

import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeLog
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeMemory
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeOwner
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.FakeScreen
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.Fixtures
import dev.kestrel.agent.testing.ScriptedModel

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class AgentRunnerTest {
    private val sent = mutableListOf<Event>()
    private val bar = mutableListOf<String>()
    private val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
    private val starts = mutableListOf<TaskStart>()
    private var latest = 1
    private var live = false
    private var now = 0L
    private val owner = FakeTaskOwner()
    private val memory = FakeMemory()
    private val log = FakeLog()
    private val touches = MutableSharedFlow<OwnerTouch>()
    private val calls = object : CallApi {
        var ended = 0

        override fun allowed() = true

        override fun answer() = Unit

        override fun end(): Boolean = true.also { ended++ }

        override fun active() = false

        override fun showInCallScreen() = Unit
    }
    private var model: ScriptedModel = ScriptedModel(listOf(fail("No such app")))
    private var environment = AgentEnvironment { start ->
        starts += start
        val chosen = (start.model as? ModelChoice.Override)?.port ?: model
        val ports = AgentPorts(
            FakeScreen(Fixtures.screen("scenario-home")), NoEyes, FakeData(), owner, chosen, FakeApps(), memory, log, FakeClock(),
        )
        Prepared.Ready(ports, AgentSettings(), owner, emptySet(), touches, "Copilot") {}
    }

    private fun TestScope.runner(debuggable: Boolean = false, options: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()) = AgentRunner(
        scope = this,
        environment = { environment.prepare(it) },
        send = { sent += it },
        latestTask = { latest },
        options = { options },
        debuggable = debuggable,
        liveSession = { live },
        deleteHistory = { if (failures.contains("delete")) error("The disk failed") },
        showOnBar = { bar += it },
        backstop = CallBackstop(calls) { now },
        report = { what, _ -> failures += what },
        nowMillis = { now },
        newId = { "task-$it-0a1b2c3d" },
    )

    private fun fail(reason: String) = ScriptedModel.call("fail", null, null, null, "reason" to reason)

    private fun ended(task: Int = 1): Event.TaskEnded? = sent.filterIsInstance<Event.TaskEnded>().singleOrNull { it.task == task }

    @Test
    fun aTaskRunsTheAgentAndEndsWithItsSentence() = runTest {
        val runner = runner()

        runner.run(1, "open Viber")
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(1, "I couldn't do it: No such app. I didn't change anything."), ended())
        assertEquals(ModelChoice.Profile(), starts.single().model)
        assertEquals("task-1-0a1b2c3d", starts.single().id)
        assertEquals(EndReason.FAILED_BY_MODEL, runner.ended(1)!!.report.end)
        assertFalse(runner.running(1))
        assertTrue(owner.closed)
    }

    @Test
    fun aDebugBuildRunsATaskOnlyWithAScriptOrInALiveSitting() = runTest {
        runner(debuggable = true).run(1, "open Viber")
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(1, AgentTexts.couldNotStart(AgentTexts.TEST_BUILD)), ended())
        assertEquals(emptyList<TaskStart>(), starts)

        val scripted = runner(debuggable = true).apply { modelOverride = ScriptedModel(listOf(fail("Scripted"))) }
        scripted.run(2, "open Viber")
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertTrue(starts.single().model is ModelChoice.Override)

        live = true
        runner(debuggable = true, options = mapOf("live" to "true", "model" to "claude-haiku-5.5")).run(3, "open Viber")
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(ModelChoice.Profile("claude-haiku-5.5"), starts.last().model)
    }

    @Test
    fun aTaskThatCannotStartSaysWhy() = runTest {
        environment = AgentEnvironment { Prepared.Refused(AgentTexts.NO_WATCHER) }
        runner().run(1, "open Viber")
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(1, AgentTexts.NO_WATCHER), ended())

        environment = AgentEnvironment { error("Kestrel broke") }
        runner().run(2, "open Viber")
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(2, AgentTexts.COULD_NOT_START), ended(2))
        assertEquals(listOf("A task"), failures)
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelTaskCancelsTheAgentWhichReportsWhatItDid() = runTest {
        owner.gateWait = CompletableDeferred()
        val runner = runner()
        runner.run(1, "open Viber")
        runCurrent()
        assertTrue(runner.running(1))

        runner.steer(Effect.CancelTask)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(1, "Cancelled. I didn't change anything."), ended())
        assertEquals(EndReason.CANCELLED, runner.ended(1)!!.report.end)
    }

    @Test
    fun theReportOfAReplacedTaskGoesToTheBar() = runTest {
        latest = 2
        runner().run(1, "open Viber")
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(listOf("Cancelled: I didn't change anything."), bar)
    }

    @Test
    fun theEffectsSteerTheOwnerPortOfTheSameTaskOnly() = runTest {
        owner.gateWait = CompletableDeferred()
        val runner = runner()
        runner.run(1, "open Viber")
        runCurrent()

        runner.steer(Effect.AnswerTask(1, "yes"))
        runner.steer(Effect.AnswerTask(2, "no"))
        runner.steer(Effect.ContinueTask(1))
        runner.steer(Effect.PauseTask(1, PauseCause.LOCK))
        runner.steer(Effect.ResumeTask(1))
        runner.steer(Effect.ExpireHandOver(1))

        assertEquals(listOf("answered yes", "continued", "paused", "resumed", "expired"), owner.steered)
        runner.steer(Effect.CancelTask)
        advanceUntilIdle()
    }

    @Test
    fun anOutgoingCallRightAfterAnActionStopsTheTaskAndSaysWhy() = runTest {
        owner.gateWait = CompletableDeferred()
        val runner = runner()
        runner.run(1, "open Viber")
        runCurrent()
        starts.single().acted()
        now = 1_000

        runner.steer(Effect.PauseTask(1, PauseCause.OUTGOING_CALL))
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(1, "${AgentTexts.CALL_STARTED} I didn't change anything."), ended())
        assertEquals(1, calls.ended)
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), owner.steered)
    }

    @Test
    fun theOwnersTouchCancelsThroughTheOrchestratorAndALateEchoIsLogged() = runTest {
        owner.gateWait = CompletableDeferred()
        val runner = runner()
        runner.run(1, "open Viber")
        runCurrent()

        touches.emit(OwnerTouch(lateEchoMillis = 230))
        runCurrent()

        assertTrue(Event.OwnerTouched in sent)
        assertTrue(log.texts(TaskLog.Kind.ACTION).contains("possible late echo after 230 ms"))
        runner.steer(Effect.CancelTask)
        advanceUntilIdle()
    }

    @Test
    fun rememberAndForgetAskTheOwnerFirst() = runTest {
        val runner = runner()
        owner.owner.answers += Answer.Yes
        runner.runMemory(1, Request.Remember("the gate code", "blue"))
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(1, AgentTexts.REMEMBERED), ended(1))
        assertEquals(listOf("the gate code" to "blue"), memory.facts.map { it.key to it.value })
        assertEquals("Remember that the gate code is blue?", owner.owner.asked.single().first)

        runner.runMemory(2, Request.Forget("the door code"))
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(2, AgentTexts.noFact("the door code")), ended(2))

        owner.owner.answers += Answer.No
        runner.runMemory(3, Request.Forget("The Gate Code"))
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(3, AgentTexts.NOT_SAVED), ended(3))
        assertEquals(listOf(Fact("the gate code", "blue", created = 0)).map { it.key }, memory.facts.map { it.key })
        assertTrue(starts.all { it.local && it.model == null })
    }

    @Test
    fun saveThatAsNeedsATaskThatFinishedInTheLastTenMinutes() = runTest {
        runner().runMemory(1, Request.SaveRoutine("test routine"))
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(Event.TaskEnded(1, AgentTexts.NOTHING_TO_SAVE), ended(1))
    }

    @Test
    fun deleteHistoryReportsWhetherItWorked() = runTest {
        val runner = runner()
        runner.steer(Effect.DeleteHistory)
        advanceUntilIdle()
        failures += "delete"
        runner.steer(Effect.DeleteHistory)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(listOf(Event.HistoryDeleted(true), Event.HistoryDeleted(false)), sent.filterIsInstance<Event.HistoryDeleted>())
    }

    @Test
    fun aPauseWhileTheTaskPreparesReachesItsOwnerPort() = runTest {
        owner.gateWait = CompletableDeferred()
        val preparing = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
        val prepare = environment
        environment = AgentEnvironment { preparing.await(); prepare.prepare(it) }
        val runner = runner()
        runner.run(1, "open Viber")
        runCurrent()

        runner.steer(Effect.PauseTask(1, PauseCause.LOCK))
        preparing.complete(Unit)
        runCurrent()

        assertEquals(listOf("paused"), owner.steered)
        runner.steer(Effect.CancelTask)
        advanceUntilIdle()
    }

    @Test
    fun aNewTaskPreparesOnlyAfterTheCancelledTaskReleased() = runTest {
        val order = mutableListOf<String>()
        owner.gateWait = CompletableDeferred()
        environment = AgentEnvironment { start ->
            order += "prepare ${start.task}"
            val ports = AgentPorts(
                FakeScreen(Fixtures.screen("scenario-home")), NoEyes, FakeData(), owner, model, FakeApps(), memory, log, FakeClock(),
            )
            Prepared.Ready(ports, AgentSettings(), owner, emptySet(), touches, "Copilot") {
                yield()
                order += "release ${start.task}"
            }
        }
        val runner = runner()
        runner.run(1, "open Viber")
        runCurrent()

        // "Stop. Kestrel, <task>": task 1's release stops the touch watcher, so task 2 starts its own only after it.
        runner.steer(Effect.CancelTask)
        runner.run(2, "open Telegram")
        runCurrent()

        assertEquals(listOf("prepare 1", "release 1", "prepare 2"), order.take(3))
        runner.steer(Effect.CancelTask)
        advanceUntilIdle()
    }

    private class FakeTaskOwner(val owner: FakeOwner = FakeOwner()) : TaskOwner, OwnerPort by owner {
        val steered = mutableListOf<String>()
        var gateWait: CompletableDeferred<Unit>? = null
        var closed = false

        override suspend fun gate(): Gate {
            gateWait?.await()
            return owner.gate()
        }

        override fun answered(answer: String?) {
            steered += "answered $answer"
        }

        override fun continued() {
            steered += "continued"
        }

        override fun paused() {
            steered += "paused"
        }

        override fun resumed() {
            steered += "resumed"
        }

        override fun handOverExpired() {
            steered += "expired"
        }

        override val handOverKind: HandOverKind? = null

        override fun close() {
            closed = true
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason

class AgentTextsTest {

        assertEquals("Sent to My Notes on Viber. The message is in My Notes.", AgentTexts.sentence(report, "Copilot"))

    @Test
    fun anyOtherEndSaysItsReasonAndWhatTheTaskDid() {

        val failed = TaskReport(EndReason.PROVIDER, error = ProviderError.Timeout)

        assertEquals("I stopped after 30 steps. I opened Viber, typed the message and scrolled down.", AgentTexts.sentence(stopped, "Copilot"))
        assertEquals("Copilot did not answer in time. I didn't change anything.", AgentTexts.sentence(failed, "Copilot"))
        assertEquals(
            "Bank Intesa is on your list of agent-free apps, so I won't act in it. I didn't change anything.",
            AgentTexts.sentence(TaskReport(EndReason.AGENT_FREE, detail = "Bank Intesa"), "Copilot"),
        )

        assertEquals("I couldn't start the task: ${AgentTexts.NO_PROFILE}", AgentTexts.couldNotStart(AgentTexts.NO_PROFILE))
    }
}
```

Create `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/AgentEnvironment.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentPorts
import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentSettings
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.OwnerPort
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

/** How a task's models are chosen (design D28 of sub-project 5). */
internal sealed interface ModelChoice {
    /**
     * The default profile's two models; [lightweight] replaces the lightweight model's ID for this task only, when the
     * debug hook's extra `model` gave one (design D30's comparison).
     */
    data class Profile(val lightweight: String? = null) : ModelChoice

    /** A model that a debug hook or a device test installed, such as the scripted model of `agent-script`. */
    data class Override(val port: ModelPort) : ModelChoice
}

/**
 * What the agent needs to start task number [task] (design D1 and D2 of sub-project 5): its ID for the logs, the owner's
 * words, the model choice (null for Kestrel's own memory requests that call no model), the debug-only self-chat aliases,
 * [acted], which the screen port calls after each action for the call backstop (design D13), and [local] for a memory
 * request, which needs neither the screen nor the touch watcher. toString prints no words.
 */
internal class TaskStart(
    val task: Int,
    val id: String,
    val text: String,
    val model: ModelChoice?,
    val selfChatAliases: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    val acted: () -> Unit = {},
    val local: Boolean = false,
) {
    override fun toString(): String = "TaskStart(task=$task, text=${text.length} characters, model=${model?.javaClass?.simpleName}, local=$local)"
}

/** A touch of the owner's that the watcher reported; [lateEchoMillis] is set when it came soon after an action of Kestrel's (D19). */
internal data class OwnerTouch(val lateEchoMillis: Long? = null)

/**
 * The owner port of one task together with the Orchestrator's effects that steer it (design D2 of sub-project 5).
 * `AppOwnerPort` implements it; `AgentRunner` calls these functions on the controller's thread, and they must not block.
 */
internal interface TaskOwner : OwnerPort {
    /** [dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.Effect.AnswerTask]: the answer that the Rules read, or null when the wait ended. */
    fun answered(answer: String?)

    /** "Kestrel, continue" ended the hand-over. */
    fun continued()

    /** A call or the lock paused the task: an open question ends as interrupted, and the gate closes. */
    fun paused()

    /** The owner said yes to "Continue the task?": the gate opens. */
    fun resumed()

    /** The hand-over lasted 3 minutes. */
    fun handOverExpired()

    /** The kind of the hand-over that is open now, or null; the debug hook `agent-state` reads it. */
    val handOverKind: HandOverKind?

    /** The category of the confirmation that is open now, or null; the debug hook `agent-state` reads it (design D28). */
    val confirming: Category? get() = null

    /** The task has ended: every wait ends, and the card and the bar's kept text go. */
    fun close()
}

/** What [AgentEnvironment.prepare] gives (design D32 item 2 of sub-project 5). */
internal sealed interface Prepared {
    /**
     * Everything that the task's agent needs: its [ports] and [settings], its [owner], the contact names that the
     * allowance may read ([knownNames], D13), the owner's [touches] while the watcher runs, the provider's name for the
     * spoken errors, and [release], which stops the touch watcher and frees what the task held.
     */
    class Ready(
        val ports: AgentPorts,
        val settings: AgentSettings,
        val owner: TaskOwner,
        val knownNames: Set<String>,
        val touches: Flow<OwnerTouch>,
        val providerName: String,
        val release: suspend () -> Unit,
    ) : Prepared {
        override fun toString(): String = "Ready(knownNames=${knownNames.size})"
    }

    /** The task cannot start; [sentence] is what Kestrel says. */
    data class Refused(val sentence: String) : Prepared {
        override fun toString(): String = "Refused(${sentence.length} characters)"
    }
}

/** Builds what each task needs from Kestrel's parts (design D1 of sub-project 5); `AppAgentEnvironment` is `:app`'s. */
internal fun interface AgentEnvironment {
    suspend fun prepare(start: TaskStart): Prepared
}
```

Create `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/AgentRunner.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.Agent
import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason
import dev.kestrel.agent.TaskCancellation
import dev.kestrel.agent.TaskReport
import dev.kestrel.agent.TaskRequest
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.Fact
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.FactKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.Recording
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.RoutineMaker
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.SaveResult
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AnswerKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.TaskLog
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.Effect
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.Event
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.Request
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import dev.kestrel.safety.Redactor
import dev.kestrel.safety.Vault
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlin.random.Random

/**
 * Runs Kestrel's tasks (design D2 of sub-project 5; D32 items 1, 2 and 4): it replaces `Listening.runTask`, so [run]
 * returns at once on the controller's thread and the agent runs in [scope], whose failures go to `graph.errors` (D32 item
 * 48). Every task ends with [Event.TaskEnded] and its sentence on every path: a task that cannot start says why ([Prepared.Refused],
 * or "I couldn't start the task." after a failure, which goes to [report] by its classes), and a cancelled one says
 * "Cancelled." with what it had done. The report of a task that "Stop. Kestrel, [task]" replaced is shown on the bar
 * ([showOnBar]), because the Rules speak only the latest task's. The effects that steer a task ([steer]) reach its owner
 * port; [Effect.CancelTask] cancels its job, and a pause that [backstop] reads as a call of the agent's stops it (D13).
 *
 * In a debuggable build ([debuggable]) a task runs only with a model that a debug hook or a device test installed
 * ([modelOverride]), or, with the hook's extra `live`, while a live sitting is open ([liveSession]); otherwise it ends at
 * once, so that no plan step, device test or script can call a provider (design D28). Release builds have no hook, so a
 * task there always uses the default profile.
 */
internal class AgentRunner(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val environment: AgentEnvironment,
    private val send: (Event) -> Unit,
    private val latestTask: () -> Int,
    private val options: (Int) -> Map<String, String>,
    private val debuggable: Boolean,
    private val liveSession: suspend () -> Boolean,
    private val deleteHistory: suspend () -> Unit,
    private val showOnBar: (String) -> Unit,
    private val backstop: CallBackstop,
    private val report: (String, Throwable) -> Unit,
    private val nowMillis: () -> Long,
    private val newId: (Int) -> String = ::taskId,
) {
    /** How task number n ended, for the debug hook `agent-task -Result`: its report and the sentence that Kestrel said. */
    internal data class Ended(val report: TaskReport, val spoken: String) {
        override fun toString(): String = "Ended(report=$report, spoken=${spoken.length} characters)"
    }

    /** Debug builds only: the model that the hook `agent-script` or a device test installed (design D28). */
    @Volatile
    internal var modelOverride: ModelPort? = null

    /** Debug builds only: the self-chat aliases that the hook `agent-settings` set (design D18); empty otherwise. */
    @Volatile
    internal var selfChatAliases: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()

    private class Running(val task: Int) {
        lateinit var job: Job

        @Volatile
        var owner: TaskOwner? = null

        // Kestrel's own sentence that replaces the report's reason, when the call backstop stopped the task.
        @Volatile
        var stopSentence: String? = null

        // A pause that came before the owner port existed; the owner port gets it as soon as it exists (design D2).
        var pausedEarly = false
    }

    private val lock = Any()
    private var current: Running? = null
    private val ends = LinkedHashMap<Int, Ended>()

    // The steps of the newest task that finished, with the time at which it finished, for "save that as" (design D23).
    @Volatile
    private var kept: Pair<Recording, Long>? = null

    /** Runs task number [task], the owner's words [text]; called on the controller's thread, it returns at once. */
    fun run(task: Int, text: String) = start(task) { running -> runTask(running, text, options(task)) }

    /** Runs Kestrel's own memory [request] as task number [task] (design D2 and D22 of sub-project 5). */
    fun runMemory(task: Int, request: Request.Memory) = start(task) { running -> runLocal(running, request) }

    /** Steers the running task with one of the Orchestrator's effects (design D2 of sub-project 5). */
    fun steer(effect: Effect) {
        val running = synchronized(lock) { current }
        when (effect) {
            Effect.CancelTask -> running?.job?.cancel(TaskCancellation(EndReason.CANCELLED))
            is Effect.ExpirePause -> running?.takeIf { it.task == effect.task }?.job?.cancel(TaskCancellation(EndReason.PAUSED_TOO_LONG))
            is Effect.AnswerTask -> running.owner(effect.task)?.answered(effect.answer)
            is Effect.ContinueTask -> running.owner(effect.task)?.continued()
            is Effect.ExpireHandOver -> running.owner(effect.task)?.handOverExpired()
            is Effect.ResumeTask -> synchronized(lock) { running?.takeIf { it.task == effect.task }?.also { it.pausedEarly = false }?.owner }?.resumed()
            is Effect.PauseTask -> {
                val target = running?.takeIf { it.task == effect.task } ?: return
                if (backstop.onPause(effect.cause) == CallBackstop.Verdict.STOP) {
                    target.stopSentence = AgentTexts.CALL_STARTED
                    target.job.cancel(TaskCancellation(EndReason.CANCELLED))
                } else {
                    synchronized(lock) { target.owner ?: null.also { target.pausedEarly = true } }?.paused()
                }
            }
            Effect.DeleteHistory -> scope.launch {
                val deleted = try {
                    deleteHistory()
                    true
                } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                    throw e
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    report("Deleting the history", e)
                    false
                }
                send(Event.HistoryDeleted(deleted))
            }
            else -> Unit
        }
    }

    /** How task number [task] ended, among the newest 16, or null while it runs or when it is older. */
    internal fun ended(task: Int): Ended? = synchronized(lock) { ends[task] }

    /** Whether task number [task] runs now. */
    internal fun running(task: Int): Boolean = synchronized(lock) { current?.task == task }

    /** The kind of the hand-over that task number [task] has open, or null. */
    internal fun handOver(task: Int): HandOverKind? = synchronized(lock) { current?.takeIf { it.task == task } }?.owner?.handOverKind

    /** The category of the confirmation that task number [task] has open, or null (the debug hook `agent-state`). */
    internal fun confirming(task: Int): Category? = synchronized(lock) { current?.takeIf { it.task == task } }?.owner?.confirming

    private fun Running?.owner(task: Int): TaskOwner? = this?.takeIf { it.task == task }?.owner

    private fun start(task: Int, body: suspend (Running) -> Unit) {
        val running = Running(task)
        val previous = synchronized(lock) { current }
        running.job = scope.launch(start = CoroutineStart.LAZY) {
            try {
                // The cancelled task before this one ends first, with its report and its release, which stops the touch
                // watcher, so that it never stops the watcher that this task starts (design D19 of sub-project 5).
                withContext(NonCancellable) { previous?.job?.join() }
                body(running)
            } finally {
                synchronized(lock) { if (current === running) current = null }
            }
        }
        synchronized(lock) { current = running }
        running.job.start()
    }

    private suspend fun runTask(running: Running, text: String, options: Map<String, String>) {
        val task = running.task
        var ready: Prepared.Ready? = null
        var spoken = false
        // Design D23: the steps of the last finished task are dropped at the next task.
        kept = null
        try {
            val choice = choose(options) ?: return refuse(task, AgentTexts.couldNotStart(AgentTexts.TEST_BUILD))
            backstop.forget()
            val start = TaskStart(task, newId(task), text, choice, selfChatAliases, backstop::acted)
            val prepared = environment.prepare(start)
            if (prepared is Prepared.Refused) return refuse(task, prepared.sentence)
            val ports = prepared as Prepared.Ready
            ready = ports
            if (synchronized(lock) { running.owner = ports.owner; running.pausedEarly }) ports.owner.paused()
            val offer = !debuggable
            var deferred: Pair<TaskReport, String>? = null
            coroutineScope {
                val touches = launch { ports.touches.collect { touched(ports, it) } }
                try {
                    Agent(ports.ports, ports.settings).run(TaskRequest(start.id, text, ports.knownNames)) { result ->
                        val sentence = running.stopSentence?.let { "$it ${AgentTexts.ledger(result)}" }
                            ?: AgentTexts.sentence(result, ports.providerName)
                        result.recording?.let { kept = it to nowMillis() }
                        record(task, result, sentence)
                        if (offer && result.offerRoutine && result.recording != null) {
                            deferred = result to sentence
                        } else {
                            spoken = true
                            ended(task, result, sentence)
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    touches.cancel()
                }
            }
            deferred?.let { (result, sentence) ->
                send(Event.TaskSays(task, sentence))
                val saved = RoutineMaker(ports.ports.model, ports.owner, ports.ports.memory, Redactor(Vault()), nowMillis = nowMillis)
                    .offer(result.recording!!, start.id)
                spoken = true
                send(Event.TaskEnded(task, (saved as? SaveResult.NotSaved)?.sentence))
            }
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            // The agent reported before it rethrew; a cancellation before the agent ran still ends the task.
            if (!spoken && ready == null) withContext(NonCancellable) { refuse(task, AgentTexts.CANCELLED) }
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            report("A task", e)
            if (!spoken) refuse(task, AgentTexts.COULD_NOT_START)
        } finally {
            ready?.let { withContext(NonCancellable) { release(it) } }
        }
    }

    // Kestrel's own memory requests ask the owner first and change nothing without his yes (design D2 and D22).
    private suspend fun runLocal(running: Running, request: Request.Memory) {
        val task = running.task
        var ready: Prepared.Ready? = null
        try {
            val choice = if (request is Request.SaveRoutine) choose(emptyMap()) ?: return refuse(task, AgentTexts.couldNotStart(AgentTexts.TEST_BUILD)) else null
            val id = newId(task)
            val prepared = environment.prepare(TaskStart(task, id, "", choice, local = true))
            if (prepared is Prepared.Refused) return refuse(task, prepared.sentence)
            val ports = prepared as Prepared.Ready
            ready = ports
            if (synchronized(lock) { running.owner = ports.owner; running.pausedEarly }) ports.owner.paused()
            val sentence = when (request) {
                is Request.Remember -> remember(ports, request)
                is Request.Forget -> forget(ports, request)
                is Request.SaveRoutine -> save(ports, request, id)
            }
            val result = TaskReport(EndReason.FINISHED)
            record(task, result, sentence.orEmpty())
            send(Event.TaskEnded(task, sentence))
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) { refuse(task, AgentTexts.CANCELLED) }
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            report("A memory request", e)
            refuse(task, AgentTexts.COULD_NOT_START)
        } finally {
            ready?.let { withContext(NonCancellable) { release(it) } }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun remember(ready: Prepared.Ready, request: Request.Remember): String {
        if (ready.owner.ask("Remember that ${request.key} is ${request.value}?", AnswerKind.YES_NO) != Answer.Yes) return AgentTexts.NOT_SAVED
        ready.ports.memory.saveFact(Fact(request.key, request.value, FactKind.FACT, nowMillis()))
        return AgentTexts.REMEMBERED
    }

    private suspend fun forget(ready: Prepared.Ready, request: Request.Forget): String {
        val wanted = Normalizer.normalize(request.key)
        val fact = ready.ports.memory.facts().firstOrNull { Normalizer.normalize(it.key) == wanted } ?: return AgentTexts.noFact(request.key)
        if (ready.owner.ask("Forget ${fact.key}?", AnswerKind.YES_NO) != Answer.Yes) return AgentTexts.NOT_SAVED
        ready.ports.memory.deleteFact(fact.key)
        return AgentTexts.FORGOTTEN
    }

    // RoutineMaker says "Saved the routine '<name>'." itself, so a saved routine ends without a sentence of its own.
    private suspend fun save(ready: Prepared.Ready, request: Request.SaveRoutine, id: String): String? {
        val (recording, at) = kept ?: return AgentTexts.NOTHING_TO_SAVE
        if (nowMillis() - at > RECORDING_MILLIS) return AgentTexts.NOTHING_TO_SAVE
        val maker = RoutineMaker(ready.ports.model, ready.owner, ready.ports.memory, Redactor(Vault()), nowMillis = nowMillis)
        return when (val result = maker.save(request.name, recording, id)) {
            is SaveResult.Saved -> null
            is SaveResult.NotSaved -> result.sentence
        }
    }

    private suspend fun choose(options: Map<String, String>): ModelChoice? {
        val override = modelOverride
        val live = options[LIVE] == "true"
        return when {
            !debuggable -> ModelChoice.Profile()
            live && liveSession() -> ModelChoice.Profile(options[MODEL])
            override != null -> ModelChoice.Override(override)
            else -> null
        }
    }

    private suspend fun touched(ready: Prepared.Ready, touch: OwnerTouch) {
        send(Event.OwnerTouched)
        touch.lateEchoMillis?.let { ready.ports.log.write(TaskLog.Kind.ACTION, "possible late echo after $it ms") }
    }

    private fun ended(task: Int, result: TaskReport, sentence: String) {
        if (latestTask() != task) showOnBar(AgentTexts.replaced(result))
        send(Event.TaskEnded(task, sentence))
    }

    private fun refuse(task: Int, sentence: String) {
        record(task, TaskReport(EndReason.NO_PROFILE), sentence)
        send(Event.TaskEnded(task, sentence))
    }

    private fun record(task: Int, result: TaskReport, sentence: String) = synchronized(lock) {
        ends[task] = Ended(result, sentence)
        while (ends.size > MAX_ENDS) ends.remove(ends.keys.first())
    }

    private suspend fun release(ready: Prepared.Ready) {
        try {
            ready.owner.close()
            ready.release()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            report("Ending a task", e)
        }
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "AgentRunner(running=${current?.task})"

    companion object {
        /** The debug hook's extras (plan 4D's TaskOptions). */
        const val MODEL = "model"
        const val LIVE = "live"

        /** How long a finished task's steps stay for "save that as" (design D23 of sub-project 5). */
        const val RECORDING_MILLIS = 10L * 60 * 1000

        const val MAX_ENDS = 16

        /** `task-<n>-<8 hexadecimal characters>` (design D25 of sub-project 5). */
        fun taskId(task: Int): String = "task-$task-%08x".format(Random.nextInt())
    }
}
```

Create `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/AgentTexts.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.EndReason
import dev.kestrel.agent.TaskReport
import dev.kestrel.app.providers.ProviderTexts
import dev.kestrel.safety.AgentFreeApps

/**
 * What Kestrel says when a task ends (design D24 of sub-project 5; spec 14.5), built by code from the task's report: a
 * finished task's confirmed sends first, then the model's summary; any other end its reason's sentence and then what the
 * task did, from its ledger ("I opened Viber and typed the message."), or "I didn't change anything.". The model's own
 * text comes already in its spoken form (placeholders as their kinds' words, at most 600 characters, D17 and D24).
 */
internal object AgentTexts {
    const val COULD_NOT_START = "I couldn't start the task."
    const val TEST_BUILD = "this test build runs tasks only with a test script or in a live session."
    const val NO_SERVICE = "Kestrel's accessibility service is off."
    const val NO_PROFILE = "No provider profile is set up. Open Kestrel to add one."
    const val NO_WATCHER = "I can't watch the screen for your touches, so I won't run the task. Turn Kestrel's accessibility " +
        "service off and on."
    const val CALL_STARTED = "I stopped the task because a call started right after my last action."
    const val CANCELLED = "Cancelled."
    const val DONE = "Done."
    const val NOTHING_CHANGED = "I didn't change anything."

    // Kestrel's own memory requests (design D2 of sub-project 5).
    const val REMEMBERED = "I'll remember that."
    const val FORGOTTEN = "I've forgotten it."
    const val NOT_SAVED = "I didn't change anything."
    const val NOTHING_TO_SAVE = "There's nothing to save: no task finished in the last 10 minutes."

    fun noFact(key: String): String = "There's no fact named $key."

    /** "I couldn't start the task." or, with a [reason], "I couldn't start the task: <reason>" (D32 item 2). */
    fun couldNotStart(reason: String? = null): String = if (reason == null) COULD_NOT_START else "I couldn't start the task: $reason"

    /** The sentence that ends task [report]; [provider] names the provider in an error's sentence. */
    fun sentence(report: TaskReport, provider: String): String = when (report.end) {
        EndReason.FINISHED -> (report.sends + (report.summary ?: DONE)).joinToString(" ")
        EndReason.UNVERIFIED ->
            report.summary?.let { "I think it's done, but I couldn't check it: ${it.trimEnd('.')}." } ?: "I think it's done, but I couldn't check it."
        else -> "${reason(report, provider)} ${ledger(report)}"
    }

    /** "Cancelled: <what the task did>", for the bar when a newer task replaced it (D32 item 4). */
    fun replaced(report: TaskReport): String = "Cancelled: ${ledger(report)}"

    /** What the task did, in Kestrel's words: "I opened Viber, typed the message and sent it." */
    fun ledger(report: TaskReport): String {
        val lines = report.ledger
        if (lines.isEmpty()) return NOTHING_CHANGED
        val joined = if (lines.size == 1) lines.single() else lines.dropLast(1).joinToString(", ") + " and " + lines.last()
        return "I $joined."
    }

    private fun reason(report: TaskReport, provider: String): String = when (report.end) {
        EndReason.FINISHED, EndReason.UNVERIFIED -> DONE
        EndReason.CANCELLED -> CANCELLED
        EndReason.FAILED_BY_MODEL -> report.detail?.let { "I couldn't do it: ${it.trimEnd('.')}." } ?: "I couldn't do it."
        EndReason.DECLINED -> "I stopped because you said no."
        EndReason.HAND_OVER_EXPIRED -> "I stopped because the step that I handed over to you took more than 3 minutes."
        EndReason.STEPS -> "I stopped after 30 steps."
        EndReason.TIME -> "I stopped because the task took too long."
        EndReason.COST -> "I stopped at the task's cost limit."
        EndReason.STUCK -> listOfNotNull("I stopped because I wasn't getting anywhere.", report.detail).joinToString(" ")
        EndReason.INVALID_CALLS -> "The model keeps giving answers that I can't use."
        EndReason.PROVIDER -> report.error?.let { ProviderTexts.spoken(it, provider) } ?: "$provider could not use the request."
        EndReason.NO_PROFILE -> NO_PROFILE
        EndReason.NO_SCREEN -> "I can't see the screen: $NO_SERVICE"
        EndReason.AGENT_FREE -> when (report.detail) {
            null, AgentFreeApps.KESTREL, "Kestrel" -> "I don't act in Kestrel's own settings."
            else -> "${report.detail} is on your list of agent-free apps, so I won't act in it."
        }
        EndReason.PAUSED_TOO_LONG -> "I stopped the task because it was paused for a long time."
        EndReason.TEST_MODE -> report.detail ?: "Test mode: Kestrel only sends to your own chats."
        EndReason.CONTEXT_TOO_SMALL -> "This model's context is too small for tasks."
        EndReason.MODEL_UNUSABLE -> report.detail ?: "The profile's model can't be used for tasks."
        EndReason.KESTREL_ERROR -> "Something went wrong in Kestrel, so I stopped the task."
    }
}
```
