- Consumes: Task 12's `TaskOwner`, `AgentTexts`; Task 10's `TaskAnswers`, `TaskAsk`, events; Tasks 6 and 7's `ScreenSession.forgetOwnActions()`, `cardShowing`, `confirm(question)`, `releaseFeedback()`, `ScreenActions.tap/longPress(key, expected, policy)`, `setText(key, text, expected)`, `scroll`, `swipe`, `global`, `openApp`, `openUri(uri, packageName, browsable)`, `openIntent(intent)`, `PressPolicy`, `ActionResult.UNCERTAIN`, `ActionResult.CHANGED`; `GesturePaths.limit`; Tasks 3 to 5's `IntentSpecs`, `MediaKeys`, `KestrelNotificationListener`; plan 5A's ports.
- Produces: `internal class AppScreenPort(session, packageManager, showBadges, hideBadges, acted) : ScreenPort` (`policy(press)`, `direction(direction)`, `outcome(result)`); `internal object AgentScreenChecks { fun expected(expect): (ScreenElement) -> Boolean; fun front(snapshot); fun inFront(snapshot, packageName, before); fun swipeArea(snapshot, key, screen) }`; `internal class AppOwnerPort(task, send, screen: OwnerScreen, audio: OtherAudio, signals: HandOverSignals, askAndroid: suspend (List<String>) -> PermissionEnd, granted: (List<String>) -> PermissionEnd) : TaskOwner` (`AUDIO_PAUSED`, `asked(kind)`, `answer(kind, answer)`); `interface OwnerScreen`, `interface OtherAudio`, `interface HandOverSignals`; `internal object Permissions { fun granted(context, permissions): PermissionEnd }`, `SessionOwnerScreen`, `AndroidOtherAudio`, `AppHandOverSignals`; `internal suspend fun awaitOutgoingCall(states: Flow<State>)`.

Design D2, D8, D11, D12, D14, D15 and D19; deferred items 17, 18, 19 and 27 (D32). `AppScreenPort` turns the agent's actions into `ScreenActions`' calls: each keyed action checks the element against what the observation showed (label, class, package, editable, password and checkable; D32 item 27), `Press` becomes `PressPolicy`, an uncertain press is reported as uncertain, a swipe is one stroke from the element's or the app window's centre, and the intents go through `openUri` and `openIntent`. After every action it tells the call backstop. While the confirmation card shows it waits until the card has gone before it reads or acts (D8), and `waitForFront` waits until the app is in front with an actionable element (D11). `AppOwnerPort` talks to the owner through the Orchestrator: questions one at a time, each after the touch watcher's credits are cleared (D19 rule 3); the Orchestrator's answer wait is the only timer (D32 item 18), and a pause withdraws the open question. A confirmation shows the card while Kestrel speaks the question; the first of the card's buttons and the voice decides, and the other is withdrawn. While another app's audio of a media or game usage plays, a confirmation of a send or a delete and the screenshot question take the voice only after Kestrel paused that audio with the media key and found it stopped (it then says "I paused the other app's audio." first); otherwise only the card's button counts (D32 item 17). A hand-over ends with "Kestrel, continue", its 3 minutes, or by itself: notification access when Kestrel's listener connects (the page opens first), a call when the owner placed it. Kestrel's own permission request is a hand-over of kind `PERMISSION` that Android's dialog ends; `askAndroid` shows the dialog (Task 14 wires a check of the permissions until plan 5B's Task 15 adds `PermissionActivity`).

Counts: `:app` JVM N + 14 (`AppOwnerPortTest` 9, `AgentScreenChecksTest` 4, `CallBackstopTest` + 1); the rest unchanged.

```kotlin
        field("Type a message", null, 2000)
        button("Send", 2000, left = 940)
    }

    @Test
    fun theElementMustStillLookAsTheObservationShowedIt() {

    }
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AnswerKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ConfirmEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Gate
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.HandOverEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.PermissionEnd
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.Event
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.TaskAsk
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.Confirmation
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOver
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitCancellation
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.TestScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runCurrent
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class AppOwnerPortTest {
    private val sent = mutableListOf<Event>()
    private val screen = object : OwnerScreen {
        val cards = mutableListOf<String>()
        var answer: CompletableDeferred<Boolean?>? = null
        var cardClosed = false
        var forgotten = 0
        var released = 0
        var watched = 0

        override suspend fun card(question: String): Boolean? {
            val shown = answer ?: return null
            cards += question
            try {
                return shown.await()
            } finally {
                cardClosed = true
            }
        }

        override fun forgetOwnActions() {
            forgotten++
        }

        override suspend fun releaseBar() {
            // As the real bar's switch to the main thread, it does nothing in a cancelled coroutine.
            currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
            released++
        }

        override suspend fun watch() {
            watched++
        }
    }
    private val audio = object : OtherAudio {
        var plays = false
        var stopsWhenPaused = true

        override fun playing() = plays

        override suspend fun pause() {
            if (stopsWhenPaused) plays = false
        }
    }
    private val ended = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    private val opened = mutableListOf<HandOverKind>()
    private val signals = object : HandOverSignals {
        override suspend fun opened(kind: HandOverKind) {
            opened += kind
        }

        override suspend fun endedByItself(kind: HandOverKind) {
            if (kind == HandOverKind.ACCESS) ended.await() else awaitCancellation()
        }
    }
    private val android = CompletableDeferred<PermissionEnd>()
    private val owner = AppOwnerPort(1, { sent += it }, screen, audio, signals, { android.await() }, { PermissionEnd.PARTLY })

    private val send = Confirmation("Send 'Hi' to Ana on Viber?", "Send to Ana on Viber: 'Hi'? Say confirm or cancel.", Category.SENDING, listOf("Ana"), "Viber", "Hi", "1", null)

    private fun <T> TestScope.started(block: suspend () -> T) = async { block() }.also { runCurrent() }

    @Test
    fun aQuestionGoesThroughTheOrchestratorAndItsAnswerComesBack() = runTest {
        val asked = started { owner.ask("Which chat?", AnswerKind.FREE) }

        assertEquals(listOf<Event>(Event.TaskAsks(1, "Which chat?", TaskAsk.FREE)), sent)
        assertEquals(1, screen.forgotten)
        owner.answered("the second one")
        assertEquals(Answer.Text("the second one"), asked.await())
        assertEquals(1, screen.released)

        val number = started { owner.ask("Which one?", AnswerKind.PICK_NUMBER) }
        owner.answered("3")
        assertEquals(Answer.Number(3), number.await())

        val yesNo = started { owner.ask("Open Viber?", AnswerKind.YES_NO) }
        owner.answered(null)
        assertEquals(Answer.Silence, yesNo.await())
    }

    @Test
    fun aPauseWithdrawsTheQuestionAndHoldsTheGateUntilTheResume() = runTest {
        val asked = started { owner.ask("Open Viber?", AnswerKind.YES_NO) }

        owner.paused()
        assertEquals(Answer.Interrupted, asked.await())
        assertEquals(Answer.Interrupted, owner.ask("Open Viber?", AnswerKind.YES_NO))
        val gate = started { owner.gate() }
        assertFalse(gate.isCompleted)

        owner.resumed()
        assertEquals(Gate.RESUMED, gate.await())
        assertEquals(Gate.GO, owner.gate())
    }

    @Test
    fun theCardAndTheVoiceAnswerAConfirmationAndTheFirstAnswerDecides() = runTest {
        screen.answer = CompletableDeferred()
        val byCard = started { owner.confirm(send) }
        assertEquals(listOf("Send 'Hi' to Ana on Viber?"), screen.cards)
        assertEquals(Event.TaskAsks(1, send.spoken, TaskAsk.CONFIRM, voice = true), sent.single())

        screen.answer!!.complete(true)
        assertEquals(ConfirmEnd.YES, byCard.await())
        assertEquals(Event.TaskBusy(1), sent.last())

        screen.answer = CompletableDeferred()
        screen.cardClosed = false
        val byVoice = started { owner.confirm(send) }
        owner.answered("no")
        assertEquals(ConfirmEnd.NO, byVoice.await())
        assertTrue(screen.cardClosed)

        screen.answer = CompletableDeferred()
        val silent = started { owner.confirm(send) }
        owner.answered(null)
        assertEquals(ConfirmEnd.TIMEOUT, silent.await())
    }

    @Test
    fun anotherAppsAudioLeavesOnlyTheCardUnlessKestrelPausedIt() = runTest {
        screen.answer = CompletableDeferred()
        audio.plays = true
        val paused = started { owner.confirm(send) }
        testScheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskAsks(1, "${AppOwnerPort.AUDIO_PAUSED} ${send.spoken}", TaskAsk.CONFIRM, voice = true), sent.last())
        owner.answered("yes")
        assertEquals(ConfirmEnd.YES, paused.await())

        audio.plays = true
        audio.stopsWhenPaused = false
        screen.answer = CompletableDeferred()
        val cardOnly = started { owner.confirm(send) }
        testScheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskAsks(1, send.spoken, TaskAsk.CONFIRM, voice = false), sent.last())
        screen.answer!!.complete(false)
        assertEquals(ConfirmEnd.NO, cardOnly.await())
    }

    @Test
    fun aHandOverEndsWithContinueItsTimeOrByItself() = runTest {
        val continued = started { owner.handOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.PAYMENT)) }
        assertEquals(Event.TaskHandsOver(1, HandOver.of(HandOverKind.PAYMENT).text), sent.single())
        assertEquals(HandOverKind.PAYMENT, owner.handOverKind)
        owner.continued()
        assertEquals(HandOverEnd.CONTINUED, continued.await())
        assertNull(owner.handOverKind)

        val expired = started { owner.handOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.CREDENTIALS)) }
        owner.handOverExpired()
        assertEquals(HandOverEnd.EXPIRED, expired.await())

        val access = started { owner.handOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.ACCESS)) }
        assertEquals(listOf(HandOverKind.PAYMENT, HandOverKind.CREDENTIALS, HandOverKind.ACCESS), opened)
        ended.complete(Unit)
        assertEquals(HandOverEnd.DONE_BY_ITSELF, access.await())
        assertEquals(Event.TaskBusy(1), sent.last())
    }

    @Test
    fun kestrelsOwnPermissionIsAHandOverThatAndroidsAnswerEnds() = runTest {
        val asked = started { owner.askPermission(listOf("android.permission.READ_CONTACTS"), "To find Ana, Kestrel needs your contacts.") }
        assertEquals(Event.TaskHandsOver(1, "To find Ana, Kestrel needs your contacts."), sent.single())
        assertEquals(HandOverKind.PERMISSION, owner.handOverKind)

        android.complete(PermissionEnd.GRANTED)
        assertEquals(PermissionEnd.GRANTED, asked.await())
        assertEquals(Event.TaskBusy(1), sent.last())

        val continued = started { AppOwnerPort(2, { sent += it }, screen, audio, signals, { awaitCancellation() }, { PermissionEnd.PARTLY }).let { other ->
            val result = async { other.askPermission(listOf("android.permission.READ_CONTACTS"), "Why") }
            runCurrent()
            other.continued()
            result.await()
        } }
        assertEquals(PermissionEnd.PARTLY, continued.await())
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledQuestionStillLetsTheBarGo() = runTest {
        val asked = started { owner.ask("Which chat?", AnswerKind.FREE) }

        asked.cancel()
        runCurrent()

        assertEquals(1, screen.released)
    }

    @Test
    fun aHandOverThatAPauseMetBeforeItBeganBeginsAfterTheResume() = runTest {
        owner.paused()
        val handedOver = started { owner.handOver(HandOver.of(HandOverKind.PAYMENT)) }
        assertFalse(handedOver.isCompleted)

        owner.resumed()
        runCurrent()
        assertEquals(Event.TaskHandsOver(1, HandOver.of(HandOverKind.PAYMENT).text), sent.single())
        owner.continued()
        assertEquals(HandOverEnd.CONTINUED, handedOver.await())
        // The watcher starts again after the pause and after the hand-over, which an instant command may have stopped.
        assertEquals(2, screen.watched)
    }

    @Test
    fun anOpenConfirmationTellsItsCategory() = runTest {
        val asked = started { owner.confirm(send) }
        assertEquals(Category.SENDING, owner.confirming)

        owner.answered("yes")
        assertEquals(ConfirmEnd.YES, asked.await())
        assertNull(owner.confirming)
    }
}
```

Create `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/AgentScreenChecks.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Expect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.IntRect
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenElement
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowKind
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.WindowSummary

/** The checks of `AppScreenPort` that need no Android (design D11 and D32 item 27 of sub-project 5). */
internal object AgentScreenChecks {
    /**
     * The `expected` predicate of `ScreenActions` for what the observation showed (D32 item 27): the element that a key
     * names now must have the same raw label, class, package, and editable, password and checkable flags, or the action
     * does nothing and gives `ActionResult.CHANGED`.
     */
    fun expected(expect: Expect): (ScreenElement) -> Boolean = { element ->
        element.label == expect.label && element.className == expect.className && element.packageName == expect.packageName &&
            element.editable == expect.editable && element.password == expect.password && element.checkable == expect.checkable
    }

    /** The app window in front: the active application window, else the top one. */
    fun front(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot): WindowSummary? {
        val apps = snapshot.windows.filter { it.kind == WindowKind.APPLICATION }
        return apps.firstOrNull { it.active } ?: apps.firstOrNull()
    }

    /**
     * Whether [packageName] is in front with an actionable element in its window (D11); with a null [packageName],
     * whether any app other than [before] is.
     */
    fun inFront(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, packageName: String?, before: String?): Boolean {
        val window = front(snapshot) ?: return false
        val app = window.packageName ?: return false
        if (if (packageName != null) app != packageName else app == before) return false
        return snapshot.elements.any { it.windowId == window.id && it.isActionable }
    }

    /** Where a swipe goes: across the element that [key] names, or across the app window in front, or the whole [screen]. */
    fun swipeArea(snapshot: ScreenSnapshot, key: String?, screen: IntRect): IntRect? =
        if (key != null) snapshot.element(key)?.bounds else front(snapshot)?.bounds ?: screen
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Answer
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AnswerKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ConfirmEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Gate
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.HandOverEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.PermissionEnd
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.Event
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.TaskAnswers
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.TaskAsk
import dev.kestrel.commands.SpokenNumbers
import dev.kestrel.safety.Category
import dev.kestrel.safety.Confirmation
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOver
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitCancellation
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelChildren
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.selects.select
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** The screen as [AppOwnerPort] needs it: the confirmation card, the touch watcher's credits and the feedback bar. */
internal interface OwnerScreen {
    /** Shows the confirmation card with [question] until a button answers it; null when no screen session is connected. */
    suspend fun card(question: String): Boolean?

    /** Clears the touch watcher's credits before a question (design D19, rule 3). */
    fun forgetOwnActions()

    /** Lets the feedback bar hide the text that a question or a hand-over kept on it. */
    suspend fun releaseBar()

    /** Starts the touch watcher again: an instant command during a hand-over or a pause stops it when it ends (D19). */
    suspend fun watch()
}

/**
 * Another app's audio of a media or game usage (design D32 item 17): Kestrel's own voice uses the assistant usage, so
 * any such player is another app's.
 */
internal interface OtherAudio {
    fun playing(): Boolean

    /** Pauses it with the media key, as `media_control`'s pause does. */
    suspend fun pause()
}

/** What `:app` does around a hand-over besides the Orchestrator (design D15). */
internal interface HandOverSignals {
    /** The hand-over of [kind] has begun; the notification-access hand-over opens Android's page here. */
    suspend fun opened(kind: HandOverKind)

    /**
     * Returns when the hand-over of [kind] ended by itself: notification access when Kestrel's listener connects, a call
     * when the owner placed it. It never returns for the other kinds.
     */
    suspend fun endedByItself(kind: HandOverKind)
}

/**
 * The owner as one task's agent talks to him (design D2, D14, D15 and D19 of sub-project 5; D32 items 17 to 21): it
 * sends the Orchestrator's events for task number [task], and the effects that the Rules send back reach it through
 * [TaskOwner]'s functions. Questions are asked one at a time, each after the touch watcher's credits are cleared. The
 * one answer wait is the Orchestrator's, which ends with an answer of null for silence; a pause withdraws the open
 * question, whose answer is then [Answer.Interrupted]. A confirmation shows the card while Kestrel speaks the question,
 * and the first answer, from the card's buttons or the voice, decides. While another app's audio plays, a confirmation
 * of a send or a delete, and the screenshot question, take the voice only after Kestrel paused that audio; when it still
 * plays, only the card's button counts. [askAndroid] shows Android's dialog for Kestrel's own permissions, and [granted]
 * checks them again when the owner says "Kestrel, continue" before the dialog answered.
 */
internal class AppOwnerPort(
    private val task: Int,
    private val send: (Event) -> Unit,
    private val screen: OwnerScreen,
    private val audio: OtherAudio,
    private val signals: HandOverSignals,
    private val askAndroid: suspend (List<String>) -> PermissionEnd,
    private val granted: (List<String>) -> PermissionEnd,
    private val audioSettleMillis: Long = AUDIO_SETTLE_MILLIS,
) : TaskOwner {
    private sealed interface Wake {
        data class Answered(val answer: String?) : Wake

        data object Continued : Wake

        data object Expired : Wake

        data object Paused : Wake
    }

    private val questions = Mutex()
    private val lock = Any()
    private var waiter: CompletableDeferred<Wake>? = null
    private var pause: CompletableDeferred<Unit>? = null

    @Volatile
    override var handOverKind: HandOverKind? = null
        private set

    @Volatile
    override var confirming: Category? = null
        private set

    override suspend fun say(text: String) = send(Event.TaskSays(task, text))

    override suspend fun ask(question: String, kind: AnswerKind): Answer = questions.withLock {
        screen.forgetOwnActions()
        try {
            if (kind == AnswerKind.SCREENSHOT && !voiceAllowed()) {
                return@withLock when (askWithCard(question, TaskAsk.FREE, voice = false)) {
                    CardOrVoice.Yes -> Answer.Yes
                    CardOrVoice.No, CardOrVoice.Silence -> Answer.No
                    CardOrVoice.Paused -> Answer.Interrupted
                }
            }
            when (val wake = wait { send(Event.TaskAsks(task, question, asked(kind))) }) {
                Wake.Paused -> Answer.Interrupted
                is Wake.Answered -> answer(kind, wake.answer)
                else -> Answer.Silence
            }
        } finally {
            // A cancelled task's coroutine still lets the bar go before the report (D32 item 1).
            withContext(NonCancellable) { screen.releaseBar() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun confirm(confirmation: Confirmation): ConfirmEnd = questions.withLock {
        screen.forgetOwnActions()
        confirming = confirmation.category
        try {
            val guarded = confirmation.category == Category.SENDING || confirmation.category == Category.DELETING
            val playing = guarded && audio.playing()
            val voice = !guarded || voiceAllowed()
            val spoken = if (playing && voice) "$AUDIO_PAUSED ${confirmation.spoken}" else confirmation.spoken
            when (askWithCard(spoken, TaskAsk.CONFIRM, voice, confirmation.question)) {
                CardOrVoice.Yes -> ConfirmEnd.YES
                CardOrVoice.No -> ConfirmEnd.NO
                CardOrVoice.Silence -> ConfirmEnd.TIMEOUT
                CardOrVoice.Paused -> ConfirmEnd.INTERRUPTED
            }
        } finally {
            confirming = null
            withContext(NonCancellable) { screen.releaseBar() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun handOver(handOver: HandOver): HandOverEnd = questions.withLock {
        handOverKind = handOver.kind
        try {
            var end: HandOverEnd? = null
            while (end == null) {
                end = coroutineScope {
                    val waking = async { wait { send(Event.TaskHandsOver(task, handOver.text)) } }
                    signals.opened(handOver.kind)
                    val itself = async { signals.endedByItself(handOver.kind) }
                    select<HandOverEnd?> {
                        waking.onAwait {
                            when (it) {
                                Wake.Expired -> HandOverEnd.EXPIRED
                                // A pause came before the Rules began the hand-over: it begins again after the resume.
                                Wake.Paused -> null
                                else -> HandOverEnd.CONTINUED
                            }
                        }
                        itself.onAwait { HandOverEnd.DONE_BY_ITSELF }
                    }.also { currentCoroutineContext().cancelChildren() }
                }
                if (end == null) gate()
            }
            // "Kestrel, continue" has set the task running again; an end by itself has not.
            if (end == HandOverEnd.DONE_BY_ITSELF) send(Event.TaskBusy(task))
            // An instant command during the hand-over stopped the touch watcher when it ended (design D19).
            screen.watch()
            end
        } finally {
            handOverKind = null
            withContext(NonCancellable) { screen.releaseBar() }
        }
    }

    // Kestrel's own permission request is a hand-over of kind PERMISSION (design D12, D15): touches do not cancel it,
    // and it ends by itself when Android's dialog answers.
    override suspend fun askPermission(permissions: List<String>, why: String): PermissionEnd = questions.withLock {
        handOverKind = HandOverKind.PERMISSION
        try {
            coroutineScope {
                val waking = async { wait { send(Event.TaskHandsOver(task, why)) } }
                val asked = async { askAndroid(permissions) }
                select {
                    asked.onAwait { end ->
                        send(Event.TaskBusy(task))
                        end
                    }
                    waking.onAwait { if (it == Wake.Expired) PermissionEnd.REFUSED else granted(permissions) }
                }.also { currentCoroutineContext().cancelChildren() }
            }.also { screen.watch() }
        } finally {
            handOverKind = null
            withContext(NonCancellable) { screen.releaseBar() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun gate(): Gate {
        val paused = synchronized(lock) { pause } ?: return Gate.GO
        paused.await()
        // An instant command during the pause stopped the touch watcher when it ended (design D19).
        screen.watch()
        return Gate.RESUMED
    }

    override fun answered(answer: String?) {
        synchronized(lock) { waiter }?.complete(Wake.Answered(answer))
    }

    override fun continued() {
        synchronized(lock) { waiter }?.complete(Wake.Continued)
    }

    override fun handOverExpired() {
        synchronized(lock) { waiter }?.complete(Wake.Expired)
    }

    override fun paused() {
        val open = synchronized(lock) {
            if (pause == null) pause = CompletableDeferred()
            waiter
        }
        open?.complete(Wake.Paused)
    }

    override fun resumed() {
        synchronized(lock) { pause.also { pause = null } }?.complete(Unit)
    }

    override fun close() {
        synchronized(lock) { pause.also { pause = null } }?.complete(Unit)
    }

    private enum class CardOrVoice { Yes, No, Silence, Paused }

    // The card and the spoken question together; the first answer decides and the other is withdrawn (D32 item 18). A
    // card's answer ends the Orchestrator's wait with TaskBusy. Without a card, only the voice can answer.
    private suspend fun askWithCard(spoken: String, kind: TaskAsk, voice: Boolean, shown: String = spoken): CardOrVoice = coroutineScope {
        val waking = async { wait { send(Event.TaskAsks(task, spoken, kind, voice)) } }
        val card = async { screen.card(shown) ?: awaitCancellation() }
        select<CardOrVoice> {
            card.onAwait { yes ->
                send(Event.TaskBusy(task))
                if (yes) CardOrVoice.Yes else CardOrVoice.No
            }
            waking.onAwait { wake ->
                when (wake) {
                    Wake.Paused -> CardOrVoice.Paused
                    is Wake.Answered -> when (wake.answer) {
                        TaskAnswers.YES -> CardOrVoice.Yes
                        null -> CardOrVoice.Silence
                        else -> CardOrVoice.No
                    }
                    else -> CardOrVoice.Silence
                }
            }
        }.also { currentCoroutineContext().cancelChildren() }
    }

    // Design D32 item 17: the voice counts only when no other app's audio plays, or after Kestrel paused it.
    private suspend fun voiceAllowed(): Boolean {
        if (!audio.playing()) return true
        audio.pause()
        delay(audioSettleMillis)
        return !audio.playing()
    }

    private suspend fun wait(start: () -> Unit): Wake {
        val waking = CompletableDeferred<Wake>()
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (pause != null) return Wake.Paused
            waiter = waking
        }
        try {
            start()
            return waking.await()
        } finally {
            synchronized(lock) { if (waiter === waking) waiter = null }
        }
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "AppOwnerPort(task=$task, handOver=$handOverKind)"

    companion object {
        const val AUDIO_PAUSED = "I paused the other app's audio."

        /** How long Android takes to report a paused player as stopped. */
        const val AUDIO_SETTLE_MILLIS = 500L

        fun asked(kind: AnswerKind): TaskAsk = when (kind) {
            AnswerKind.YES_NO -> TaskAsk.YES_NO
            AnswerKind.PICK_NUMBER -> TaskAsk.PICK_NUMBER
            AnswerKind.FREE, AnswerKind.SCREENSHOT -> TaskAsk.FREE
        }

        /** The agent's answer for the Rules' [answer] to a question of [kind]; null is silence. */
        fun answer(kind: AnswerKind, answer: String?): Answer = when {
            answer == null -> Answer.Silence
            kind == AnswerKind.YES_NO -> if (answer == TaskAnswers.YES) Answer.Yes else Answer.No
            kind == AnswerKind.PICK_NUMBER -> SpokenNumbers.answer(answer)?.let { Answer.Number(it) } ?: Answer.Silence
            else -> Answer.Text(answer)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ActionOutcome
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Badge
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Direction
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.GlobalKind
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.IntentSpec
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Press
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ScreenAction
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ScreenPort
import dev.kestrel.datatools.IntentSpecs
import dev.kestrel.screen.ScreenSession
import dev.kestrel.screen.act.ActionResult
import dev.kestrel.screen.act.GesturePaths
import dev.kestrel.screen.act.GlobalAction
import dev.kestrel.screen.act.PressPolicy
import dev.kestrel.screen.act.ScrollDirection
import dev.kestrel.screen.model.ScreenSnapshot
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull

/**
 * The screen as the agent sees and moves it (design D1, D8, D11 and D32 items 27 and 29 of sub-project 5), through the
 * screen session that is connected when each step runs ([session]). Each action checks the element against what the
 * observation showed ([AgentScreenChecks.expected]) and presses as [Press] says; an uncertain press is reported as such.
 * The intents go through `ScreenActions.openUri` and `openIntent`, which Android lets Kestrel's accessibility service
 * start from the background. After every action, also a failed one, [acted] tells the call backstop (D13). While the
 * confirmation card shows, the port waits until it has gone before it reads or acts (D8). The numbers of look_closer go
 * through [showBadges] and [hideBadges], which plan 5C sets.
 */
internal class AppScreenPort(
    private val session: () -> ScreenSession?,
    private val packageManager: PackageManager,
    private val showBadges: suspend (ScreenSession, List<Badge>) -> Unit,
    private val hideBadges: suspend (ScreenSession) -> Unit,
    private val acted: () -> Unit,
) : ScreenPort {
    override suspend fun snapshot(): ScreenSnapshot? {
        val screen = session() ?: return null
        afterCard(screen)
        return screen.snapshots.current().snapshot
    }

    override suspend fun act(action: ScreenAction): ActionOutcome {
        val screen = session() ?: return ActionOutcome(done = false, reason = AgentTexts.NO_SERVICE)
        afterCard(screen)
        val result = try {
            perform(screen, action)
        } finally {
            acted()
        }
        return outcome(result)
    }

    override suspend fun resolve(intent: IntentSpec): String? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { IntentSpecs.resolve(packageManager, intent) }

    override suspend fun showBadges(badges: List<Badge>) {
        session()?.let { showBadges(it, badges) }
    }

    override suspend fun hideBadges() {
        session()?.let { hideBadges(it) }
    }

    override suspend fun waitForFront(packageName: String?, millis: Long, before: String?): Boolean {
        val screen = session() ?: return false
        return withTimeoutOrNull(millis) {
            while (!AgentScreenChecks.inFront(screen.snapshots.current().snapshot, packageName, before)) delay(POLL_MILLIS)
            true
        } ?: false
    }

    private suspend fun perform(screen: ScreenSession, action: ScreenAction): ActionResult {
        val actions = screen.actions
        return when (action) {
            is ScreenAction.Tap -> actions.tap(action.key, AgentScreenChecks.expected(action.expect), policy(action.press))
            is ScreenAction.LongPress -> actions.longPress(action.key, AgentScreenChecks.expected(action.expect), policy(action.press))
            is ScreenAction.TapAt -> actions.tapAt(action.x, action.y)
            is ScreenAction.SetText -> actions.setText(action.key, action.text, AgentScreenChecks.expected(action.expect))
            is ScreenAction.Scroll -> actions.scroll(direction(action.direction), action.key, action.expect?.let(AgentScreenChecks::expected))
            is ScreenAction.Swipe -> swipe(screen, action)
            is ScreenAction.Global -> actions.global(if (action.kind == GlobalKind.BACK) GlobalAction.BACK else GlobalAction.HOME)
            is ScreenAction.OpenApp -> actions.openApp(action.packageName)
            is ScreenAction.OpenUri -> actions.openUri(action.uri, action.packageName, action.browsable)
            is ScreenAction.OpenIntent -> actions.openIntent(IntentSpecs.toIntent(action.spec))
        }
    }

    // One complete stroke (D32 item 29) from the centre of the element or of the app window, a third of the screen in
    // the finger's direction, as the instant command "swipe up" goes.
    private suspend fun swipe(screen: ScreenSession, action: ScreenAction.Swipe): ActionResult {
        val snapshot = screen.snapshots.current().snapshot
        val element = action.key?.let { snapshot.element(it) ?: return ActionResult.CHANGED }
        if (element != null && action.expect?.let { !AgentScreenChecks.expected(it)(element) } == true) return ActionResult.CHANGED
        val bounds = screen.screenBounds
        val area = AgentScreenChecks.swipeArea(snapshot, action.key, bounds) ?: return ActionResult.CHANGED
        val line = GesturePaths.limit(bounds, area.centerX, area.centerY, direction(action.direction)) ?: return OFF_SCREEN
        return screen.actions.swipe(line.fromX, line.fromY, line.toX, line.toY)
    }

    // Design D8: after a confirmation, the card's window must be gone before the screen is read or acted on.
    private suspend fun afterCard(screen: ScreenSession) {
        if (!screen.cardShowing) return
        withTimeoutOrNull(CARD_MILLIS) { while (screen.cardShowing) delay(POLL_MILLIS) }
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "AppScreenPort(connected=${session() != null})"

    companion object {
        const val POLL_MILLIS = 100L
        const val CARD_MILLIS = 2_000L
        private val OFF_SCREEN = ActionResult.Failed("The point is outside the screen.")

        fun policy(press: Press): PressPolicy = when (press) {
            Press.ONCE -> PressPolicy.ONCE
            Press.VERIFIED -> PressPolicy.VERIFIED
        }

        fun direction(direction: Direction): ScrollDirection = when (direction) {
            Direction.UP -> ScrollDirection.UP
            Direction.DOWN -> ScrollDirection.DOWN
            Direction.LEFT -> ScrollDirection.LEFT
            Direction.RIGHT -> ScrollDirection.RIGHT
        }

        /**
         * What the agent learns of an action: a failure with its fixed sentence, and an uncertain press as done and
         * uncertain, because plan 5A's `ScreenSteps` reads `uncertain` only on an outcome that is done. It then judges the
         * press by the screen, and the next press of a send needs a new yes (design D32 item 29 of sub-project 5).
         */
        fun outcome(result: ActionResult): ActionOutcome = when (result) {
            is ActionResult.Done -> ActionOutcome(done = true, method = result.method.name.lowercase())
            ActionResult.UNCERTAIN -> ActionOutcome(done = true, uncertain = true)
            is ActionResult.Failed -> ActionOutcome(done = false, reason = result.reason)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
/**
 * Returns when [states] show a call that became active without ringing first, which is a call that the owner placed (the
 * CALL hand-over of design D15 then ends by itself). A call that rang is an incoming call and does not count.
 */
internal suspend fun awaitOutgoingCall(states: Flow<State>) {
    var rang = false
    states.first { state ->
        if (state.mode == Mode.RINGING) rang = true
        state.mode == Mode.IN_CALL && !rang
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.media.AudioAttributes
import android.media.AudioManager
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.MediaAction
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.PermissionEnd
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.State
import dev.kestrel.datatools.media.MediaKeys
import dev.kestrel.datatools.notifications.KestrelNotificationListener
import dev.kestrel.safety.HandOverKind
import dev.kestrel.screen.ScreenSession
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitCancellation
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first

/** Kestrel's own permissions as Android holds them now (design D12 of sub-project 5). */
internal object Permissions {
    fun granted(context: Context, permissions: List<String>): PermissionEnd {
        val held = permissions.count { context.checkSelfPermission(it) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }
        return when (held) {
            permissions.size -> PermissionEnd.GRANTED
            0 -> PermissionEnd.REFUSED
            else -> PermissionEnd.PARTLY
        }
    }
}

/** The screen session that is connected when a question is asked, as [AppOwnerPort] needs it. */
internal class SessionOwnerScreen(private val session: () -> ScreenSession?) : OwnerScreen {
    override suspend fun card(question: String): Boolean? = session()?.confirm(question)

    override fun forgetOwnActions() {
        session()?.forgetOwnActions()
    }

    override suspend fun releaseBar() {
        session()?.releaseFeedback()
    }

    // Starting a running watcher only updates its layout and clears the credits.
    override suspend fun watch() {
        session()?.startTouchWatcher()
    }
}

/**
 * The other apps' audio of a media or game usage (design D32 item 17). An ordinary app gets the players without their
 * UIDs, but Kestrel's own voice uses the assistant usage, so any such player is another app's.
 */
internal class AndroidOtherAudio(context: Context) : OtherAudio {
    private val audio = context.getSystemService(AudioManager::class.java)

    override fun playing(): Boolean = audio.activePlaybackConfigurations.any { it.audioAttributes.usage in OTHER_USAGES }

    override suspend fun pause() {
        MediaKeys(audio).press(MediaAction.PAUSE)
    }

    private companion object {
        val OTHER_USAGES = setOf(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA, AudioAttributes.USAGE_GAME)
    }
}

/**
 * The hand-overs that end by themselves (design D9 and D15 of sub-project 5): notification access opens Android's page
 * through [open] and ends when Kestrel's listener connects; a call ends when the Orchestrator's [states] show an outgoing
 * call (Kestrel sees the call state only with READ_PHONE_STATE, and only while it listens).
 */
internal class AppHandOverSignals(
    private val context: Context,
    private val open: suspend (Intent) -> Boolean,
    private val states: Flow<State>,
) : HandOverSignals {
    override suspend fun opened(kind: HandOverKind) {
        if (kind == HandOverKind.ACCESS) open(KestrelNotificationListener.accessSettings(context))
    }

    override suspend fun endedByItself(kind: HandOverKind) {
        when (kind) {
            HandOverKind.ACCESS -> KestrelNotificationListener.connected.first { it }
            HandOverKind.CALL -> awaitOutgoingCall(states)
            else -> awaitCancellation()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        val vertex = profile("google-vertex", "claude-opus-5@20261001", region = "europe-west4")

        assertEquals(ProfileChecks.VERTEX_LOCATION, ProfileChecks.unusable(vertex, RequestStyle.VERTEX, ModelEntry("claude-opus-5@20261001", "Claude Opus 5")))
        assertNull(ProfileChecks.unusable(vertex.copy(region = "global"), RequestStyle.VERTEX, ModelEntry("claude-opus-5", "Claude Opus 5")))
        assertNull(ProfileChecks.unusable(vertex, RequestStyle.VERTEX, ModelEntry("claude-opus-5-5", "Claude Opus 5.5")))
        val arn = "arn:aws:bedrock:eu-west-1:123456789012:application-inference-profile/abc"
        assertEquals(ProfileChecks.BEDROCK_PROFILE, ProfileChecks.unusable(profile("amazon-bedrock", arn), RequestStyle.BEDROCK, ModelEntry(arn, arn)))
        val ollama = profile("ollama", "qwen3:4b", local = LocalServerKind.OLLAMA)
        assertEquals(ProfileChecks.OLLAMA_WINDOW, ProfileChecks.unusable(ollama, null, ModelEntry("qwen3:4b", "qwen3:4b", contextWindow = 8_192)))
        assertNull(ProfileChecks.unusable(ollama, null, ModelEntry("qwen3:4b", "qwen3:4b", contextWindow = 32_768)))
    }

    @Test
    fun theModelInfoTakesTheTasksLightweightModelAndTheSignedThinking() {
        val anthropic = profile("anthropic", "claude-haiku-4-5", versatile = "claude-sonnet-5-5")

        val info = ModelInfos.of(anthropic, null, emptyList(), lightweight = "claude-haiku-5-5")

        assertEquals("claude-haiku-5-5", info.lightweight.id)
        assertTrue(info.lightweight.signedThinking)
        assertTrue(info.versatile.signedThinking)
        assertFalse(ModelInfos.of(profile("github-copilot", "claude-sonnet-5-5"), null, emptyList()).versatile.signedThinking)
        assertFalse(ModelInfos.of(anthropic, null, emptyList()).lightweight.signedThinking)
        val local = ModelInfos.of(profile("ollama", "qwen3:4b", local = LocalServerKind.OLLAMA), null, listOf(DiscoveredModel("qwen3:4b", "qwen3:4b", contextWindow = 8_192)))
        assertTrue(local.localOllama)
        assertEquals(ProfileChecks.OLLAMA_WINDOW, local.lightweight.unusable)
    }

    @Test
    fun aModelWhoseExplicitCacheReadsNothingFromStepThreeLosesTheExplicitMode() = runTest {
        val sent = mutableListOf<CacheFields>()
        var usage = Usage(input = 500, output = 10, cacheRead = 0)
        val info = ModelInfos.of(profile("github-copilot", "gpt-6-luna", versatile = "gpt-6.1-terra"), null, emptyList())
        val port = AppModelPort(info, CacheState { CacheFields.ALL }) { _, request ->
            sent += request.cacheFields
            PricedResponse(ChatResponse(ChatMessage.Assistant(emptyList()), StopReason.END, usage, "gpt-6-luna"), Cost(0.0, 0.0, estimated = false, priceKnown = true, planUsage = false), RequestStyle.RESPONSES)
        }
        val request = ChatRequest("system", listOf(ChatMessage.User(listOf(Part.Text("hi")))), maxOutputTokens = 100)

        port.call(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, request, step = 3)
        usage = Usage(input = 2_000, output = 10, cacheRead = 0)
        port.call(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, request, step = 2)
        port.call(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, request, step = 3)
        port.call(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT, request, step = 4)
        port.call(ModelRole.VERSATILE, request, step = 4)

        // The first request had too few tokens and the second came before step 3; the versatile model keeps the mode.
        assertEquals(listOf(true, true, true, false, true), sent.map { it.responsesExplicit })
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.TaskLog
import dev.kestrel.privacy.logs.ActivityEvent
import dev.kestrel.privacy.logs.ActivityKind
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class LogTaskLogTest {
    @Test
    fun eachEntryCarriesTheTasksIdAndItsKindAndAFailureNeverEndsTheTask() = runTest {
        val written = mutableListOf<ActivityEvent>()
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        val log = LogTaskLog("task-3-0a1b2c3d", { if (it.kind == ActivityKind.ERROR) error("The disk is full") else written += it }) { what, _ -> failures += what }

        log.write(TaskLog.Kind.START, "started")
        log.write(TaskLog.Kind.PROMPT, "step 1")
        log.write(TaskLog.Kind.ERROR, "failed")

        assertEquals(
            listOf(ActivityEvent(ActivityKind.NOTE, "started", "task-3-0a1b2c3d"), ActivityEvent(ActivityKind.PROMPT, "step 1", "task-3-0a1b2c3d")),
            written,
        )
        assertEquals(listOf("Writing a task's log entry"), failures)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.Fact
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.FactKind
import dev.kestrel.privacy.crypto.AesGcmFieldCipher
import dev.kestrel.privacy.db.SettingRow
import dev.kestrel.privacy.db.SettingsDao
import dev.kestrel.privacy.settings.SettingsStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import javax.crypto.KeyGenerator

class SettingsMemoryStoreTest {
    private val key = KeyGenerator.getInstance("AES").apply { init(256) }.generateKey()
    private val settings = SettingsStore(MemoryDao(), AesGcmFieldCipher { key }, dispatcher = Dispatchers.Unconfined)
    private val approvals = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
    private val memory = SettingsMemoryStore(settings, { p, id -> (p to id) in approvals }, { p, id -> approvals += p to id })

    @Test
    fun aFactWithTheSameKeyReplacesTheOldOneAndForgettingFindsItTheSameWay() = runTest {
        memory.saveFact(Fact("the gate code", "blue"))
        memory.saveFact(Fact("The Gate Code", "red", FactKind.FACT, created = 5))
        memory.saveFact(Fact("mom", "contact Mama", FactKind.ALIAS))

        assertEquals(listOf("red", "contact Mama"), memory.facts().map { it.value })
        assertTrue(memory.deleteFact("the gate code"))
        assertFalse(memory.deleteFact("the gate code"))
        assertEquals(listOf("mom"), memory.facts().map { it.key })
    }

    @Test
    fun theSignaturesCountAndTheFoundContactsKeepTheNewestTwenty() = runTest {
        assertEquals(1, memory.countSignature("open-viber"))
        assertEquals(2, memory.countSignature("open-viber"))
        memory.addFoundContacts((1..19).map { "Person $it" })
        memory.addFoundContacts(listOf("Ana", "Person 3", "Marko"))

        val found = memory.foundContacts()
        assertEquals(20, found.size)
        assertEquals(listOf("Marko", "Person 3", "Ana", "Person 19"), found.take(4))
    }

    @Test
    fun deleteAllEmptiesEveryStoreOfMemoryAndTheApprovalsAreTheGraphs() = runTest {
        memory.saveFact(Fact("the gate code", "blue"))
        memory.countSignature("open-viber")
        memory.addFoundContacts(listOf("Ana"))
        memory.approveScreenshots("org.mozilla.firefox", "github-copilot")

        memory.deleteAll()

        assertEquals(emptyList<Fact>(), memory.facts())
        assertEquals(emptyMap<String, Int>(), memory.signatures())
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), memory.foundContacts())
        assertTrue(memory.screenshotApproved("org.mozilla.firefox", "github-copilot"))
    }

    private class MemoryDao : SettingsDao {
        val rows = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, SettingRow>>(emptyMap())

        override suspend fun get(name: String): SettingRow? = rows.value[name]

        override fun observe(name: String): Flow<SettingRow?> = rows.map { it[name] }

        override suspend fun put(row: SettingRow) {
            rows.value = rows.value + (row.name to row)
        }

        override suspend fun delete(name: String): Int = if (rows.value.containsKey(name)) 1.also { rows.value = rows.value - name } else 0
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.telecom.TelecomManager
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentPorts
import dev.kestrel.agent.AgentSettings
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AgentClock
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.AppsPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.Badge
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.EyesPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.LauncherApp
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelInfo
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.NoEyes
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.PermissionEnd
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.RoleModel
import dev.kestrel.app.SettingKeys
import dev.kestrel.app.commands.AndroidDialer
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.Event
import dev.kestrel.app.orchestrator.State
import dev.kestrel.app.providers.ProviderGraph
import dev.kestrel.datatools.AndroidDataPort
import dev.kestrel.privacy.logs.ActivityEvent
import dev.kestrel.privacy.settings.SettingsStore
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatRequest
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.RequestStyle
import dev.kestrel.providers.client.PlanLimits
import dev.kestrel.providers.client.PricedResponse
import dev.kestrel.providers.client.ProfileClient
import dev.kestrel.providers.discovery.DiscoveredModel
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.ModelRole
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.Profile
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.ProvidersSetting
import dev.kestrel.safety.AgentFreeApps
import dev.kestrel.safety.EmergencyGuard
import dev.kestrel.safety.EmergencyNumbers
import dev.kestrel.screen.ScreenSession
import dev.kestrel.screen.act.ActionResult
import dev.kestrel.screen.act.OwnActions
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.emptyFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.filter
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import java.time.ZonedDateTime

/**
 * Builds what each task needs from Kestrel's parts (design D1, D2, D12, D13, D16 and D19 of sub-project 5). A task needs
 * the accessibility service and the touch watcher: without the service it cannot start ("I couldn't start the task:
 * Kestrel's accessibility service is off."), and when the watcher's window cannot be added it does not run
 * ([AgentTexts.NO_WATCHER]). Kestrel's own memory requests ([TaskStart.local]) need neither. The settings come from the
 * encrypted store when the task starts: the mode, test mode and the owner's names, the agent-free apps with the owner's
 * changes, Android's emergency-number check and the phone apps with the default one. [eyes] and the badge functions are
 * read at each task, because plan 5C sets them. Release stops the watcher and drops the task's media items.
 */
internal class AppAgentEnvironment(
    private val context: Context,
    private val session: () -> ScreenSession?,
    private val settings: SettingsStore,
    private val memory: SettingsMemoryStore,
    private val appendLog: suspend (ActivityEvent) -> Unit,
    private val models: AppModels,
    private val send: (Event) -> Unit,
    private val states: Flow<State>,
    private val eyes: () -> EyesPort,
    private val showBadges: suspend (ScreenSession, List<Badge>) -> Unit,
    private val hideBadges: suspend (ScreenSession) -> Unit,
    private val askAndroid: suspend (List<String>) -> PermissionEnd,
    private val knownNames: suspend () -> Set<String>,
    private val report: (String, Throwable) -> Unit,
) : AgentEnvironment {
    private val apps = AndroidApps(context)

    override suspend fun prepare(start: TaskStart): Prepared {
        val screen = session()
        if (screen == null && !start.local) return Prepared.Refused(AgentTexts.couldNotStart(AgentTexts.NO_SERVICE))
        val model = when (val choice = start.model) {
            null -> NoModel
            is ModelChoice.Override -> choice.port
            is ModelChoice.Profile -> models.port(choice.lightweight) ?: return Prepared.Refused(AgentTexts.NO_PROFILE)
        }
        val agentSettings = agentSettings(start)
        val open: suspend (Intent) -> Boolean = { intent -> session()?.actions?.openIntent(intent) is ActionResult.Done }
        val data = AndroidDataPort(context, open, agentSettings.agentFree::isAgentFree)
        val owner = AppOwnerPort(
            start.task,
            send,
            SessionOwnerScreen(session),
            AndroidOtherAudio(context),
            AppHandOverSignals(context, open, states),
            askAndroid,
            { Permissions.granted(context, it) },
        )
        val ports = AgentPorts(
            AppScreenPort(session, context.packageManager, showBadges, hideBadges, start.acted),
            if (start.local) NoEyes else eyes(),
            data,
            owner,
            model,
            apps,
            memory,
            LogTaskLog(start.id, appendLog, report),
            AndroidAgentClock,
        )
        val provider = model.model.providerName
        if (start.local || screen == null) return Prepared.Ready(ports, agentSettings, owner, emptySet(), emptyFlow(), provider) {}
        if (!screen.startTouchWatcher()) return Prepared.Refused(AgentTexts.NO_WATCHER)
        val touches = screen.touches.filter { it.owner }.map { touch ->
            OwnerTouch(touch.sinceNodeActionMillis?.takeIf { it <= OwnActions.LATE_ECHO_MILLIS })
        }
        return Prepared.Ready(ports, agentSettings, owner, knownNames(), touches, provider) {
            screen.stopTouchWatcher()
            data.forgetTask()
        }
    }

    private suspend fun agentSettings(start: TaskStart): AgentSettings {
        val changes = settings.get(SettingKeys.AGENT_FREE_APPS)
        val telephony = context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)
        val phoneApp = context.getSystemService(TelecomManager::class.java)?.defaultDialerPackage
        return AgentSettings(
            safety = settings.get(SettingKeys.SAFETY),
            agentFree = AgentFreeApps(changes.added.toSet(), changes.removed.toSet()),
            emergency = EmergencyNumbers { digits -> AndroidDialer.emergency(telephony, digits) },
            phonePackages = EmergencyGuard.PHONE_PACKAGES + listOfNotNull(phoneApp),
            selfChatAliases = start.selfChatAliases,
        )
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "AppAgentEnvironment"

    // Kestrel's own memory requests call no model (design D2 of sub-project 5).
    private object NoModel : ModelPort {
        private val none = RoleModel("none", "none", RequestStyle.CHAT_COMPLETIONS, null, takesImages = false, signedThinking = false)

        override val model = ModelInfo("Kestrel", "kestrel", countsCredits = false, localOllama = false, lightweight = none, versatile = none)

        override suspend fun call(role: ModelRole, request: ChatRequest, step: Int): PricedResponse =
            throw IllegalStateException("Kestrel's own memory requests call no model.")
    }
}

/**
 * The default profile's models for a task (design D1, D5, D7 and D28 of sub-project 5): it waits up to 5 s for the store
 * to answer, because just after the process starts the repository answers null although a profile exists, and then
 * gives null only when no default profile is set up. A task's [port] with a lightweight model ID of its own (the debug
 * hook's extra `model`) gets a client that resolves that ID for the lightweight role and the profile's model for the
 * versatile one.
 */
internal class AppModels(
    private val providers: () -> ProviderGraph,
    private val applied: StateFlow<ProvidersSetting?>,
    private val discovered: suspend (profileId: String) -> List<DiscoveredModel>,
    private val cache: CacheState,
    private val report: (String, Throwable) -> Unit,
) {
    suspend fun port(lightweight: String?): ModelPort? {
        val graph = providers()
        withTimeoutOrNull(STORED_WAIT_MILLIS) { graph.stored.first { it != null } }
        val client = graph.repository.defaultClient() ?: return null
        val profile = client.profile
        val info = ModelInfos.of(profile, graph.catalog.provider(profile.providerId), discovered(profile.id), lightweight)
        val chosen = if (lightweight == null) client else withLightweight(graph, profile, lightweight)
        return AppModelPort(info, cache, chosen::complete)
    }

    private fun withLightweight(graph: ProviderGraph, profile: Profile, lightweight: String) = ProfileClient(
        profile,
        graph.catalog,
        applied,
        { current, role ->
            val resolved = if (role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT) current.copy(lightweight = current.lightweight.copy(id = lightweight)) else current
            graph.resolver.resolve(resolved, role)
        },
        graph::adapter,
        graph.localNetwork,
        graph::addSpending,
        NO_LIMITS,
        report = report,
    )

    override fun toString(): String = "AppModels"

    private companion object {
        const val STORED_WAIT_MILLIS = 5_000L

        // A comparison run of the debug hook does not mark a ChatGPT plan's limit.
        val NO_LIMITS = object : PlanLimits {
            override fun reached(profileId: String) = Unit

            override fun cleared(profileId: String) = Unit
        }
    }
}

/** The launcher apps of the owner's profile (design D11 of sub-project 5), read with the `<queries>` of spec 13.6. */
internal class AndroidApps(private val context: Context) : AppsPort {
    override suspend fun launcherApps(): List<LauncherApp> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val packages = context.packageManager
        val launcher = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)
        packages.queryIntentActivities(launcher, PackageManager.ResolveInfoFlags.of(0))
            .map { info ->
                val app = info.activityInfo.packageName
                LauncherApp(info.loadLabel(packages).toString(), app, version(packages, app))
            }
            .distinctBy { it.packageName }
    }

    override suspend fun label(packageName: String): String? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val packages = context.packageManager
        try {
            packages.getApplicationLabel(packages.getApplicationInfo(packageName, PackageManager.ApplicationInfoFlags.of(0))).toString()
        } catch (e: PackageManager.NameNotFoundException) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun version(packages: PackageManager, app: String): String? = try {
        packages.getPackageInfo(app, PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(0)).versionName
    } catch (e: PackageManager.NameNotFoundException) {
        null
    }
}

/** Kestrel's working time, which a sleeping phone does not stop, and the local time of the task message. */
internal object AndroidAgentClock : AgentClock {
    override fun elapsedMillis(): Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()

    override fun now(): ZonedDateTime = ZonedDateTime.now()
}
```

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelInfo
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.ModelPort
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.RoleModel
import dev.kestrel.providers.catalog.CatalogLoader
import dev.kestrel.providers.catalog.InputKind
import dev.kestrel.providers.catalog.LocalServerKind
import dev.kestrel.providers.catalog.ModelEntry
import dev.kestrel.providers.catalog.ProviderEntry
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.CacheFields
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.ChatRequest
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.RequestStyle
import dev.kestrel.providers.chat.Usage
import dev.kestrel.providers.client.ModelEntries
import dev.kestrel.providers.client.PricedResponse
import dev.kestrel.providers.discovery.DiscoveredModel
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.ModelRole
import dev.kestrel.providers.profiles.Profile
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/**
 * The default profile's two models for one task (design D1, D5 and D7 of sub-project 5): [complete] is the profile's
 * `ProfileClient.complete`. Each call carries the cache fields that [cache] gives for the role's model, and its answer
 * tells [cache] whether the explicit Responses mode worked.
 */
internal class AppModelPort(
    override val model: ModelInfo,
    private val cache: CacheState,
    private val complete: suspend (ModelRole, ChatRequest) -> PricedResponse,
) : ModelPort {
    override suspend fun call(role: ModelRole, request: ChatRequest, step: Int): PricedResponse {
        val id = (if (role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT) model.lightweight else model.versatile).id
        val fields = cache.fields(id)
        val answer = complete(role, request.copy(cacheFields = fields))
        cache.answered(id, step, fields, answer.response.usage)
        return answer
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "AppModelPort(provider=${model.providerId})"
}

/**
 * Which of Copilot's cache fields the requests carry (design D5 of sub-project 5): the stored setting `AGENT_CACHE_FIELDS`
 * ([stored], which only the debug hook `agent-cache` changes), and, for the rest of the process, without the explicit
 * Responses mode for a model whose request of step 3 or later, above 1,024 input tokens, read nothing from the cache:
 * dropped markers disable caching without an error (r51). One state serves every task.
 */
internal class CacheState(private val stored: suspend () -> CacheFields) {
    private val withoutExplicit: MutableSet<String> = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet()

    suspend fun fields(modelId: String): CacheFields {
        val fields = stored()
        return if (modelId in withoutExplicit) fields.copy(responsesExplicit = false) else fields
    }

    fun answered(modelId: String, step: Int, fields: CacheFields, usage: Usage) {
        if (fields.responsesExplicit && step >= 3 && usage.totalInput > MIN_INPUT && usage.cacheRead == 0L) withoutExplicit += modelId
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "CacheState(withoutExplicit=${withoutExplicit.size})"

    companion object {
        const val MIN_INPUT = 1_024L
    }
}

/**
 * The profile checks before a task (design D32 items 36 and 37 of sub-project 5; the controller's decision 4 for plan
 * 5B): a role whose model cannot work gets the sentence that says why, which the agent speaks when it is the lightweight
 * model and which keeps it from escalating when it is the versatile one.
 */
internal object ProfileChecks {
    const val VERTEX_LOCATION = "Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 work on Vertex only in the global, us and eu locations. Change the profile's location or model."
    const val BEDROCK_PROFILE = "Kestrel can't use Bedrock application inference profiles yet. Choose the model by its own ID."
    const val OLLAMA_WINDOW = "This model's context is too small for tasks: Kestrel needs at least 12,000 tokens. Choose a larger model, or raise the server's context length."

    /** The system prompt and the tools take about 4,000 tokens, and the agent asks for 4,096 output tokens. */
    const val MIN_OLLAMA_WINDOW = 12_000

    private val VERTEX_LOCATIONS = setOf("global", "us", "eu")
    private val CLAUDE_5 = Regex("^claude-(opus|sonnet)-5(@[\\w.-]+|-\\d{8})?$", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private const val APPLICATION_PROFILE = ":application-inference-profile/"

    fun unusable(profile: Profile, style: RequestStyle?, entry: ModelEntry): String? = when {
        style == RequestStyle.VERTEX && profile.region !in VERTEX_LOCATIONS && CLAUDE_5.matches(entry.id) -> VERTEX_LOCATION
        style == RequestStyle.BEDROCK && APPLICATION_PROFILE in entry.id -> BEDROCK_PROFILE
        profile.localServer == LocalServerKind.OLLAMA && (entry.contextWindow ?: Int.MAX_VALUE) < MIN_OLLAMA_WINDOW -> OLLAMA_WINDOW
        else -> null
    }
}

/** What the agent knows of a profile (design D1 and D7 of sub-project 5): no key and no token. */
internal object ModelInfos {
    // The Claude models that keep their signed thinking (D32 item 9): Opus, Sonnet and Haiku from 5.5 on, Fable and Mythos from 5.1 on.
    private val SIGNED_THINKING = Regex("(^|[-/.])claude-((opus|sonnet|haiku)-(5-[5-9]|[6-9])|(fable|mythos)-(5-[1-9]|[6-9]))(?=$|[^a-z0-9])")

    /**
     * The profile's two models, as the catalog row of [provider] and the profile's last model list ([discovered]) describe
     * them; [lightweight] replaces the lightweight model's ID for this task only (design D28).
     */
    fun of(profile: Profile, provider: ProviderEntry?, discovered: List<DiscoveredModel>, lightweight: String? = null): ModelInfo {
        val copilot = profile.providerId == CatalogLoader.COPILOT
        fun role(role: ModelRole): RoleModel {
            val chosen = profile.model(role).let { if (role == ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT && lightweight != null) it.copy(id = lightweight) else it }
            val entry = ModelEntries.withOwnerChoices(ModelEntries.entryFor(provider, chosen.id, discovered), chosen)
            val style = chosen.style ?: entry.style ?: provider?.style
                ?: if (profile.localServer == LocalServerKind.OLLAMA) RequestStyle.OLLAMA else RequestStyle.CHAT_COMPLETIONS
            return RoleModel(
                name = entry.name,
                id = entry.id,
                style = style,
                contextWindow = entry.contextWindow,
                takesImages = InputKind.IMAGE in entry.input,
                signedThinking = !copilot && SIGNED_THINKING.containsMatchIn(entry.id.lowercase().replace(Regex("[._\\s]+"), "-")),
                unusable = ProfileChecks.unusable(profile, provider?.style, entry),
            )
        }
        return ModelInfo(
            providerName = provider?.label ?: profile.providerId,
            providerId = profile.providerId,
            countsCredits = copilot,
            localOllama = profile.localServer == LocalServerKind.OLLAMA,
            lightweight = role(ModelRole.LIGHTWEIGHT),
            versatile = role(ModelRole.VERSATILE),
        )
    }
}
```

Create `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/LogTaskLog.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.TaskLog
import dev.kestrel.privacy.logs.ActivityEvent
import dev.kestrel.privacy.logs.ActivityKind
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException

/**
 * One task's entries in the encrypted activity log (design D25 and D32 item 46 of sub-project 5), with the task's ID
 * [taskId]. The agent writes them already redacted. A failed write goes to [report] by its classes and never ends the
 * task.
 */
internal class LogTaskLog(
    private val taskId: String,
    private val append: suspend (ActivityEvent) -> Unit,
    private val report: (String, Throwable) -> Unit,
) : TaskLog {
    override suspend fun write(kind: TaskLog.Kind, text: String) {
        try {
            append(ActivityEvent(kindOf(kind), text, taskId))
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            report("Writing a task's log entry", e)
        }
    }

    override fun toString(): String = "LogTaskLog(task=$taskId)"

    companion object {
        fun kindOf(kind: TaskLog.Kind): ActivityKind = when (kind) {
            TaskLog.Kind.START, TaskLog.Kind.END -> ActivityKind.NOTE
            TaskLog.Kind.PROMPT -> ActivityKind.PROMPT
            TaskLog.Kind.REPLY -> ActivityKind.REPLY
            TaskLog.Kind.SAFETY -> ActivityKind.SAFETY
            TaskLog.Kind.ACTION -> ActivityKind.ACTION
            TaskLog.Kind.ERROR -> ActivityKind.ERROR
        }
    }
}
```

Create `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/SettingsMemoryStore.kt`:

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.Fact
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.RouteNote
import dev.kestrel.agent.memory.Routine
import dev.kestrel.agent.port.MemoryStore
import dev.kestrel.app.SettingKeys
import dev.kestrel.commands.text.Normalizer
import dev.kestrel.privacy.settings.SettingKey
import dev.kestrel.privacy.settings.SettingsStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock

/**
 * Kestrel's memory in its encrypted settings (design D22 and D23 of sub-project 5): the facts and aliases, the route
 * notes per app (at most 20, the oldest gone first), the routines, the counts of `finish` signatures and the names of
 * the contacts that the last tasks found (at most [MAX_FOUND], newest first, for the boost words of D32 item 44). Keys of
 * facts and routines match after `Normalizer`, so "The gate code" replaces "the gate code". The screenshot approvals are
 * plan 5C's: [approved] and [approve] read the app graph's functions at each call. One writer at a time.
 */
internal class SettingsMemoryStore(
    private val settings: SettingsStore,
    private val approved: suspend (packageName: String, providerId: String) -> Boolean,
    private val approve: suspend (packageName: String, providerId: String) -> Unit,
) : MemoryStore {
    private val writes = Mutex()

    override suspend fun facts(): List<Fact> = settings.get(SettingKeys.MEMORY_FACTS)

    override suspend fun saveFact(fact: Fact) = change(SettingKeys.MEMORY_FACTS) { facts -> facts.filterNot { same(it.key, fact.key) } + fact }

    override suspend fun deleteFact(key: String): Boolean {
        var found = false
        change(SettingKeys.MEMORY_FACTS) { facts -> facts.filterNot { same(it.key, key) }.also { found = it.size < facts.size } }
        return found
    }

    override suspend fun notes(packageName: String): List<RouteNote> = settings.get(SettingKeys.ROUTE_NOTES)[packageName].orEmpty()

    override suspend fun saveNotes(packageName: String, notes: List<RouteNote>) =
        change(SettingKeys.ROUTE_NOTES) { all -> if (notes.isEmpty()) all - packageName else all + (packageName to notes.takeLast(MAX_NOTES)) }

    override suspend fun addFoundContacts(names: List<String>) =
        change(SettingKeys.FOUND_CONTACTS) { found -> (names.reversed() + found).distinctBy { Normalizer.normalize(it) }.take(MAX_FOUND) }

    override suspend fun screenshotApproved(packageName: String, providerId: String): Boolean = approved(packageName, providerId)

    override suspend fun approveScreenshots(packageName: String, providerId: String) = approve(packageName, providerId)

    override suspend fun routines(): List<Routine> = settings.get(SettingKeys.ROUTINES)

    override suspend fun saveRoutine(routine: Routine) =
        change(SettingKeys.ROUTINES) { routines -> routines.filterNot { same(it.name, routine.name) } + routine }

    override suspend fun countSignature(signature: String): Int {
        var count = 0
        change(SettingKeys.ROUTINE_SIGNATURES) { counts ->
            count = (counts[signature] ?: 0) + 1
            counts + (signature to count)
        }
        return count
    }

    /** Every app's route notes, for the Memory page. */
    suspend fun allNotes(): Map<String, List<RouteNote>> = settings.get(SettingKeys.ROUTE_NOTES)

    suspend fun deleteNotes(packageName: String) = change(SettingKeys.ROUTE_NOTES) { it - packageName }

    suspend fun deleteRoutine(name: String): Boolean {
        var found = false
        change(SettingKeys.ROUTINES) { routines -> routines.filterNot { same(it.name, name) }.also { found = it.size < routines.size } }
        return found
    }

    suspend fun signatures(): Map<String, Int> = settings.get(SettingKeys.ROUTINE_SIGNATURES)

    suspend fun foundContacts(): List<String> = settings.get(SettingKeys.FOUND_CONTACTS)

    /** "Delete all memory" (spec 5.1 goal 4; design D22): the facts, notes, routines, signatures and found contacts. */
    suspend fun deleteAll() = writes.withLock {
        for (key in listOf(SettingKeys.MEMORY_FACTS, SettingKeys.ROUTE_NOTES, SettingKeys.ROUTINES, SettingKeys.ROUTINE_SIGNATURES, SettingKeys.FOUND_CONTACTS)) {
            reset(key)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun <T> reset(key: SettingKey<T>) = settings.set(key, key.default)

    private suspend fun <T> change(key: SettingKey<T>, update: (T) -> T) = writes.withLock { settings.set(key, update(settings.get(key))) }

    private fun same(a: String, b: String): Boolean = Normalizer.normalize(a) == Normalizer.normalize(b)

    override fun toString(): String = "SettingsMemoryStore"

    companion object {
        const val MAX_NOTES = 20
        const val MAX_FOUND = 20
    }
}
```

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/PermissionActivity.kt`, `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/PermissionRequests.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` (below `<!-- sub-project 5B: components -->`), `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/settings/SetupChecklist.kt`, `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/settings/SetupStatusReader.kt`, `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/settings/SettingsApp.kt`, `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/settings/ChecklistPage.kt`, `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/settings/SettingsData.kt` (below both 5B anchors), `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/MainActivity.kt`, `app/src/main/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/AppGraph.kt` (an import, `askAndroid` in `agentEnvironment`, and below `// sub-project 5B: keys`), `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` (below `<!-- sub-project 5B -->`), `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-kestrel-design.md` (15's checklist)
- Test: `app/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/agent/PermissionRequestsTest.kt` (new), `app/src/test/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/settings/SetupChecklistTest.kt`, `app/src/androidTest/kotlin/dev/kestrel/app/settings/SettingsAppTest.kt`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: plan 5A's `PermissionEnd` (`dev.kestrel.agent.port`); Task 13's `internal object Permissions { fun granted(context: Context, permissions: List<String>): PermissionEnd }` (package `dev.kestrel.app.agent`) and `AppOwnerPort`'s `askAndroid: suspend (List<String>) -> PermissionEnd`, which keeps the task handed over (kind `PERMISSION`) while it runs; Task 14's wiring line in `AppGraph.kt`'s `agentEnvironment`; Task 5's `KestrelNotificationListener.hasAccess(context)` and `accessSettings(context)`; `SettingKey` and `kotlinx.serialization.builtins.serializer`, which `AppGraph.kt` imports since Task 12's `AGENT_LIVE_SESSION`.
- Produces: `class PermissionActivity` (`EXTRA_PERMISSIONS`, `EXTRA_REQUEST`, `suspend fun ask(context, permissions): PermissionEnd`, `fun intent(context, permissions, request): Intent`); `internal object PermissionRequests` (`ask(start, granted)`, `waits(id)`, `ended(id)`); `SetupStep.NOTIFICATION_ACCESS` and `SetupStep.AGENT_FREE_APPS` (after `PROVIDER`); `SetupStatus.notificationAccess` and `agentFreeReviewed`; `SetupAction.NOTIFICATION_ACCESS`; `ChecklistPage`'s `onOpenSafety`; `SettingsData.agentFreeReviewed: Flow<Boolean>` (default `flowOf(false)`); `SettingKeys.AGENT_FREE_REVIEWED` (Boolean, false), which Task 16's Safety page sets; the strings `setup_notification_access_*`, `setup_open_notification_access`, `setup_agent_free_*` and `setup_open_agent_free`.

Design D12, D15 and D26. A tool that lacks its runtime permission returns `NeedsPermission`, and the agent calls `OwnerPort.askPermission`; Task 13's `AppOwnerPort` says why, hands the task over (kind `PERMISSION`: touches do not cancel it, the instant commands work, and its 3 minutes run) and calls `askAndroid`. Task 14 wired `askAndroid` to a check that asks nothing; this task gives it `PermissionActivity.ask`: a transparent activity with `excludeFromRecents` and `taskAffinity=""`, but without `noHistory`, because such an activity never gets the result of what it starts (review A2-I5), asks Android for the permissions together and ends with `finishAndRemoveTask()`, so that the task's app comes back. The hand-over ends by itself when Android's dialog answers or when the activity goes away for any reason but a configuration change (`isChangingConfigurations`; a rotation during the dialog gives its answer to the new instance, review A3-N4), and the permissions are then read again with `checkSelfPermission`, so that a lost answer never hangs a task and Android 14's partial photo access counts as `PARTLY`. `PermissionFlowTest` (Task 19) checks the whole flow on a fresh install. The checklist gets the two optional steps of D26 after `PROVIDER`: `NOTIFICATION_ACCESS` opens Android's page for Kestrel's listener and shows the restricted-settings sentence of Task 5 (spec 13.6), and `AGENT_FREE_APPS` opens the Safety page, whose suggestions Task 16 adds and which sets the flag `AGENT_FREE_REVIEWED` when the owner has reviewed them once. Spec 15's checklist gets the two steps (D31).

Expected test counts after this task: `:app` JVM N + 4 (`PermissionRequestsTest` 3, `SetupChecklistTest` 1); `:app` device tests in `dev.kestrel.app.settings` N + 2; the other groups unchanged.

```kotlin
package dev.kestrel.app.agent

import dev.kestrel.agent.port.PermissionEnd
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runCurrent
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class PermissionRequestsTest {
    @Test
    fun permissionsThatAndroidGrantedAskNothing() = runTest {
        var started = 0

        val end = PermissionRequests.ask(start = { started++; true }, granted = { PermissionEnd.GRANTED })

        assertEquals(PermissionEnd.GRANTED, end)
        assertEquals(0, started)
    }

    @Test
    fun aRequestEndsWhenItsActivityEndsAndReadsThePermissionsAgain() = runTest {
        var request = 0L
        var now = PermissionEnd.REFUSED
        val end = async { PermissionRequests.ask(start = { request = it; true }, granted = { now }) }
        runCurrent()
        assertTrue(PermissionRequests.waits(request))

        // As after Android's dialog, in which the owner allowed only the photos that he selected.
        now = PermissionEnd.PARTLY
        PermissionRequests.ended(request)

        assertEquals(PermissionEnd.PARTLY, end.await())
        assertFalse(PermissionRequests.waits(request))
    }

    @Test
    fun anActivityThatDoesNotStartEndsTheRequestAtOnce() = runTest {
        var request = 0L

        val end = PermissionRequests.ask(start = { request = it; false }, granted = { PermissionEnd.REFUSED })

        assertEquals(PermissionEnd.REFUSED, end)
        assertFalse(PermissionRequests.waits(request))
    }
}
```
